proposal.reasoning:
MEASUREMENT SETUP. Scan is 3094x4489. Bright-region projection puts the paper at rows 226-4235, cols 458-3091; the solid runs at x 470-484 and x 3045-3089 (one unbroken dark run y1578-4199) are scan/binding edge, not ink, and are not boxed. An ink projection (px<120) across x470-3090, y300-4200 returns exactly 16 column runs: the two edges, one narrow margin column at x905-956, and thirteen text columns.

MARU-MARKERS. There is NO maru-marker (circle + name + 藩) anywhere on this page — I checked every column run top to bottom. The page is entirely a continuation of one domain's block, so the right-to-left ownership rule has nothing to switch on here and owner_domain_jp is 郡山藩 for every box. neighbour_domains is therefore empty.

RUNNING HEADER / PROVENANCE. The leftmost margin column (x905-956) holds two separate ink groups: y1273-1829 and y3106-3147. Cropped at 3x and 6x these read 藩制一覽表第六（郡山）and 五. So this is fascicle 6 (table_number 6) and the printed book page is 五. The header names 郡山, which agrees with the page content (see below), so provenance and data domain match.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (native x of each ink run):
col1 x2613-2689 — 受領一斗六升八合 (y1096-1742), then 同 (y2345-2389), then 明源寺 (y2932-3492).
col2 x2487-2556 — 正税米　四升 (label y1183-1409, value y1519-1663).
col3 x2334-2433 — 受領二十五石; warichu location 江州高島郡海 / 津中小路寺町; 寶幢院.
col4 x2222-2290 — 正税　二十石.
col5 x2064-2162 — 受領五石; 江州高島郡 / 中村町; 大崎寺.
col6 x1956-2025 — 正税　四石.
col7 x1794-1892 — 受領一石九斗; 同 / 中小路町; 宗正寺.
col8 x1683-1752 — 正租　一石八斗.
col9 x1523-1623 — 受領百六十石六斗二升七合; 江州坂田郡 / 柏原村; 成菩提院.
col10 x1416-1487 — 正租　五十九石三斗五升六合七勺六才.
col11 x1264-1362 — 受領六石五斗一升; 和州式下郡 / 黒田村; 法樂寺.
col12 x1157-1225 — 正税　五石八斗五升九合.
col13 x1002-1103 — 受領三石四升; 和州添下郡郡 / 山洞泉寺町; 洞泉寺.

PAIRING OF 受領 WITH 正税/正租. The columns alternate 受領, 正税/正租, starting and ending with 受領, and the temple name and location print only under the 受領 columns. Three things settle which tax column goes with which temple. (a) Indentation: every 受領 column's first glyph starts at y≈1096, every 正税/正租 column's first glyph starts at y≈1183, one character lower — the tax line is the subordinate continuation line, so it follows the 受領 line it sits to the LEFT of. (b) The page's last column is a 受領 line (洞泉寺) with no tax line to its left; its tax line runs onto the next page. (c) Magnitudes: pairing each 受領 with the tax column on its left gives 25/20, 5/4, 1.9/1.8, 6.51/5.859, 160.627/59.357, 0.168/0.04 — tax below grant in every case. Pairing the other way makes the tax exceed the grant in four of six pairs (e.g. 20 koku tax on a 5 koku grant), which is not possible. So the tax box is assigned to the temple named in the column to its right.

GLYPH CHECKS (single-character runs measured, then cropped at 3-6x). 十 vs 千: the 十 in 二十五石, 二十石, 百六十石 and 五十九石 is a plain cross with no ノ on top — no x100 error. 三 vs 二: run-lengths separate them cleanly. In col10 the glyph after 石 is three thin horizontals (y1773-1779, 1791-1799, 1815-1823) = 三; in col9 the glyph after 升's predecessor is two thin horizontals (y1777-1786, 1811-1820) = 二; in col13 three horizontals (y1271-1280, 1291-1299, 1315-1323) = 三. 六 vs 二: 六 shows a wide lid run plus a wide splayed-leg run (23px + 27px), e.g. col10 y2107-2164 and y2445-2503 — both 六, not 二. 八 vs 人: the 八 in 八合 (col1), 一石八斗 (col8) and 五石八斗 (col12) is separated at the top and splays — 八 confirmed; no 人 appears on this page (no demographic block here, so no M/F split to sum-validate). 七 vs 九: col9's 七合 has the horizontal-plus-hooked-vertical; col12's 九合 and col7's 九斗 have the rounded bending leg. 石 vs 右 checked after every digit. Sub-unit order is strictly descending in every value (石>斗>升>合>勺>才), including the six-place 五十九石三斗五升六合七勺六才 = 59.35676, so no place is out of order.

WARICHU LOCATIONS. Six of the seven locations print as double-column inline notes; the right sub-column is read first. col13's right sub-column ends …添下郡郡 and the left begins 山…, giving 和州添下郡郡山洞泉寺町 — the castle town of Kōriyama itself, which independently confirms the header's 郡山 as the domain whose block this is. The Ōmi holdings (高島郡海津, 中村町, 中小路町, 坂田郡柏原村) and the Yamato holdings (式下郡黒田村, 添下郡郡山) are both consistent with Kōriyama han's scattered landholding.

CROSS-CHECK AGAINST MASTER. MASTER supplies no rows for this page, so every transcription here is read off the scan with no dataset to compare against.

BOXES. 29 boxes: 13 amount boxes (label + value enclosed together, e.g. 正税 label at y1183 through 四升 at y1663), 7 location boxes, 7 temple-name boxes, the running header and the printed page number. Location and name are boxed separately because ~520px of blank paper separates them in every column. A programmatic pairwise test on the final box list returns zero overlaps. Two overlay renders (_final.png plus zoomed crops of the left-top and right-bottom regions) confirm every box is flush — no glyph pokes out, no box sits on whitespace. The faint facing-page bleed-through visible mid-page is far lighter than the <120 ink threshold and is not boxed.
proposal.page_header_en: Han Institutions at a Glance, Fascicle 6 (Kōriyama)
proposal.page_topic: Temple grants and their assessed tax (fascicle 6)
proposal.page_summary_en: A continuation page from Kōriyama domain's fascicle-6 return, listing seven Buddhist temples with the rice grant each receives (受領) and the regular tax or rent assessed on that holding (正税 / 正租). The seven are Myōgen-ji (0.168 koku received, 0.04 koku tax in rice), Hōdō-in at Kaizu Nakakōji Teramachi in Takashima district of Ōmi (25 koku received, 20 koku tax), Ōsaki-ji at Nakamura-chō in the same district (5 and 4 koku), Sōshō-ji at Nakakōji-chō (1.9 and 1.8 koku), Jōbodai-in at Kashiwabara village in Sakata district of Ōmi (160.627 koku received against 59.35676 koku tax, by far the largest entry), Hōraku-ji at Kuroda village in Shikige district of Yamato (6.51 and 5.859 koku), and Tōsen-ji in Tōsenji-chō of Kōriyama castle town (3.04 koku received; its tax line runs onto the next page). The locations split between Ōmi province, where four of the temples stand, and Yamato province, where the domain's castle town lay, which records how scattered Kōriyama's landholding was. No domain marker appears on the page, so all seven entries belong to Kōriyama.

proposal.reasoning:
RENDER + STRUCTURE. Native scan 3095x4489. The paper occupies x=49..2669, y=243..4239; the black band at x>=2618 (y3153-4234) and the strip at x=60..72 are scan/binding edge, not ink, and are not boxed. An ink projection over the paper interior returns 16 column runs; two of them (x1116-1122 sum=52px, x2280-2290 sum=103px) are specks and one (x2618-2664) is the binding edge, leaving 13 text columns plus the running header and the printed page number.

MARKERS. There is NO maru-marker (circle + name + 藩) anywhere on the page — I checked the top of every column run for a circle glyph and none exists. So the right-to-left ownership rule has nothing to bite on here: the page is a continuation leaf, and every box belongs to the single domain named in the running header. Consequently neighbour_domains is empty — this page gives no evidence of an adjacent domain on either side.

HEADER (provenance). Rightmost text column, x2192-2253, y1302-1858, read at 3x: 藩制一覽表第六（郡山）. Fascicle six, domain Kōriyama. Because there is no marker, the header's parenthetical is the only domain attribution available, and I use it: 郡山藩 (Yamato Kōriyama). Note the page itself prints only 郡山 inside the parentheses, without 藩. The printed book-page number is a single glyph set sideways in the outer margin at x2165-2221, y3137-3178, read at 4x = 四 (page 4).

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT. The leaf is a temple/shrine fief register. Each entry occupies one wide column carrying, top to bottom, the granted holding (受領…), then a two-sub-column warichu giving the location, then the institution's name set with wide letter-spacing; the tax details for that entry then follow in the narrower columns immediately to its LEFT, before the next entry's header column begins. That pattern holds five times without exception, which is how I assigned every detail column to the entry on its right.

1. x2062-2148 (y1121-1451): 受領十石 = 10 koku. Same column lower: warichu 江州高島郡 / 海津中小路町 (x2015-2136, y2375-2780) and the spaced name 天神社 (x2019-2107, y2960-3538).
2. x1917-2013 (y1207-2201): 正税米三石四斗二升八合. Units descend 石>斗>升>合 = 3.428 koku. Belongs to 天神社.
3. x1791-1865 (y1117-1819): 受領十一石四斗 = 11.4 koku. 十 is a plain cross, not 千, checked at 2.4x. Immediately left of it, x1866-1916 (y1523-1828), a warichu in parentheses: （四斗朱書）— the 4-to fraction was entered in vermillion in the manuscript. The main column's glyph tips reach x1871 in the y1100-1500 band where the warichu has not yet started; a column profile over x1770-1940 puts the true gap at x1861-1862 in the warichu band, so I set the box boundary at x1866. Each box clips at most 6px of thin stroke tip, and the clipped ink falls inside the neighbouring box. Location warichu 江州蒲生郡 / 中村; name 西光寺.
4. x1641-1745 (y1202-2370): 正税米八石四斗六升六合四勺 = 8.4664 koku, five descending places. Belongs to 西光寺.
5. x1521-1611 (y1110-1609): 受領百二十石 = 120 koku (百, 二, 十 read separately at 2.6x; the 十 is a plain cross, not 千). Location 江州坂田郡 / 下司村; name 總持寺.
6. x1395-1483 (y1192-1693): 外ニ込高五升 = an additional komidaka of 0.05 koku. The final glyph is 升 (0.01), not 斗, checked at 2.6x. Belongs to 總持寺.
7. x1246-1353 (y1194-2358): 正租米六十三石五斗七升六合 = 63.576 koku. The second glyph is 租 (禾 + 且), not 税 (禾 + 兌) — the two are separated at 2.6x by the right-hand component. Belongs to 總持寺.
8. x1120-1223 (y1188-2188): 雜税米二石一斗二升四合 = 2.124 koku. Belongs to 總持寺.
9. x999-1094 (y1114-1766): 受領一斗四升八合 = 0.148 koku. Location 江州坂田郡 / 柏原村; name 敬誓寺 (both glyphs zoomed at 5x: 苟+攵 = 敬; 折 over 言 = 誓).
10. x877-965 (y1185-1684): 正税米三升 = 0.03 koku. The numeral was zoomed to a single character at 8x and shows three horizontal strokes with a shorter middle bar = 三, not 二. Belongs to 敬誓寺.
11. x744-832 (y1095-1596): 受領五斗四升 = 0.54 koku. Location 江州坂田郡 / 柏原村; name 安立寺.
12. x609-697 (y1180-1505): 正税無之 = no regular tax. Belongs to 安立寺.
13. x457-567 (y1176-1924): 雜税　鏹一貫五百文 = 1,500 mon in cash. The currency glyph was zoomed at 9x: 金 radical plus 弓+口+虫 = 強, giving 鏹, not 錢. Belongs to 安立寺.

ARITHMETIC NET. This leaf has no total-and-component structure — no 男/女 split, no 内訳, no 合高 against 本田/新田 — so no sum check applies. The available consistency test is the unit ordering inside each koku figure, and all nine koku values run strictly 石 > 斗 > 升 > 合 > 勺 with no place out of order. The tax-to-holding ratios (34.3%, 74.3%, 54.7% including the miscellaneous rice, 20.3%) vary across entries, which is expected for separately assessed temple fiefs and is not an arithmetic constraint.

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER supplies no rows for this page and names no fascicle for it, so nothing could be compared; every value above comes from reading the scan.

GEOMETRY. All 26 boxes were measured by ink projection inside a rough region and padded 9px, then tested pairwise: zero overlaps. A 6px-strip test around each box found ink only where the adjacent box already covers it (the three-way warichu junction at x1860-1921) plus 3px beside 敬誓寺's holding column. One overlay was rendered to _final.png and read; every box sits flush on its glyph run, none sits on whitespace, so no correcting second pass was needed.
proposal.page_header_en: Table of Domain Institutions, Fascicle Six (Kōriyama)
proposal.page_topic: Temple and shrine fiefs in Ōmi and their tax yields
proposal.page_summary_en: This leaf of fascicle six, printed book page 4, records five religious foundations that held fiefs in Ōmi province (江州) under Yamato Kōriyama domain, each entry giving the granted holding, the location, the institution's name, and the tax taken from it. Tenjinsha at Kaizu Nakakōji-chō in Takashima district holds 10 koku and pays 3.428 koku of regular tax rice; Saikōji at Naka-mura in Gamō district holds 11.4 koku, with the 4-to fraction entered in vermillion, and pays 8.4664 koku. Sōjiji at Geshi-mura in Sakata district is much the largest, holding 120 koku plus an additional komidaka of 0.05 koku and paying 63.576 koku of regular rent rice together with 2.124 koku of miscellaneous tax rice. The two Kashiwabara-mura foundations in the same district are minute by comparison: Kyōseiji holds 0.148 koku and pays 0.03 koku, while Anryūji holds 0.54 koku, owes no regular tax at all, and pays a cash miscellaneous tax of 1,500 mon.

proposal.reasoning:
MARKER AND OWNERSHIP. One maru-marker on the page: ○敦賀藩, measured by ink-projection at x1804-1890, y1338-1882 (four large elements ○/敦/賀/藩, glyph heights 76-80px). By the right-to-left rule everything RIGHT of x1890 was read earlier and belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything LEFT of it belongs to 敦賀藩. There is no second marker, so the page holds exactly two domains.

IDENTIFYING THE PREVIOUS DOMAIN. The right-hand block prints no domain name. I opened the facing recto, outputs/walkthrough/hi_viewer/images/lower_p192_right.jpg (printed page 三百六十, header 藩制一覽表第九（鶴舞、鶴牧）): it ends with ○鶴牧藩 followed by 大參事 二人 and 權大參事 五人, under which only four names are printed (井上八郎右衞門, 本田新平, 山上左仲, 佐久間丈右衞門). The first column of the present page, 靑木久兵衞, carries no office label above it, and it completes that five. So the right-hand block is 鶴牧藩 (Kazusa), and 靑木久兵衞 is its fifth 權大參事.

LAYOUT. Two registers. Register 1 has a label band (y ~995-1930) above a name band (y ~2000-2580); a label and the first name under it share one column. Register 2 (y ~2757-3500) has no separate bands, so an office label there consumes its own column and its names begin one column to the left. Column x-runs measured on the ink projection, right to left: A 2615-2679, B 2483-2558, C 2336-2423, D 2204-2281, E 2079-2150, F 1952-2018, G 1804-1890 (marker), H 1669-1750, I 1531-1616, J 1371-1474, K 1267-1352, L 1129-1210, M 973-1084 (double-width: it holds a name above and a two-column warichu below), N 780-940 (running header and printed page number).

WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
Col A: 靑木久兵衞 (5 glyphs, y2001-2575), no label — 鶴牧藩 權大參事, carried over from the facing page.
Col B: label band 少參事 (3 glyphs y1001-1229) + 一人 (y ~1430-1564); name band 石井文藏 (4 glyphs).
Col C: label band 權少參事 (4 glyphs y1000-1313) + 五人 (y1422-1559); name band 豐田愼藏; register 2 大多和文平.
Col D: 小幡治兵衞; register 2 關甫 (two glyphs widely spaced, y2932-2992 and y3434-3495).
Col E: 本多要.
Col F: 兵隊 (2 glyphs) + 百二十人 (y1321-1632). 十 is a plain cross, not 千 — checked at single-character zoom.
Col G: the ○敦賀藩 marker.
Col H: label 大參事; name 寺町四郎左衞門 (7 glyphs); register 2 label 權少參事.
Col I: label 權大參事; name 寺町元之進; register 2 三浦多仲.
Col J: 平山小太郎; register 2 丹羽九十九 (十 again a plain cross, verified at 8x). A small ink blob at x1371-1394, y895-929 is a printing speck and is not boxed.
Col K: label 少參事; name 眞田五郎左衞門; register 2 label 少參事 again.
Col L: small-type annotation 公用役兼 (glyph heights 43-46px against 55-63px for the full-size labels) at y1676-1924; name 永田新; register 2 加藤淸右衞門.
Col M: 都筑記鈕; below it the two-column warichu 右家令申付候ニ付少參事ヲ兼候哉不分明トノ屆書.
Col N: running header 藩制一覽表第九（敦賀）at y1259-1817 and the printed page number 三百六十一 at y3105-3331.

ARITHMETIC CHECK ON THE COUNTS. 少參事 一人 → one name in its column, 石井文藏 (1 = 1). 權少參事 五人 → 豐田愼藏 (C), 小幡治兵衞 (D), 本多要 (E) in register 1, then 大多和文平 (C) and 關甫 (D) in register 2, five in all (5 = 5). 權大參事 五人 on the facing page → four names there plus 靑木久兵衞 here (4 + 1 = 5). All three reconcile, which is what fixed the register rule: had the names begun one column left of their label in register 1, the 權少參事 list would have reached only four.

敦賀藩 prints no person counts and no 兵隊 line on this page; only the office names and the men holding them. Its offices run in rank order across the two registers: 大參事 (寺町四郎左衞門), 權大參事 (寺町元之進, 平山小太郎), 少參事 (眞田五郎左衞門, 永田新, 都筑記鈕), then 權少參事 (三浦多仲, 丹羽九十九) and a second 少參事 entry (加藤淸右衞門) appended last because of the caveat in the warichu.

TWO READINGS I CHECKED AT SINGLE-CHARACTER ZOOM. (1) The last glyph of 公用役兼 and the second glyph of the warichu's left column are the same character; the bottom is 八 with the vertical passing between the legs and there are two full-width horizontals, so 兼, not 衆. In the warichu 兼 is forced by the grammar (…ヲ兼候哉 = "whether he also holds"). The annotation therefore reads "concurrently serving as 公用役", printed at the head of the column holding 永田新; whether it also covers 都筑記鈕 in the next column cannot be settled from the type alone. (2) The warichu's first left-column glyph is the looped small-print form of ヲ, and the mark at y3166-3210 is ノ, giving 不分明トノ屆書.

MASTER carries no rows for this page, so nothing could be cross-checked against it; every reading above is from the scan.

GEOMETRY. All 29 boxes are flush ink bounding boxes (threshold px<115, projected onto rows and columns, padded 9px). A pairwise test found no overlaps. Two overlay passes were rendered to _final.png and a 1.4x detail crop; no box clips a glyph or sits on whitespace. Not boxed: the facing-page bleed-through down the middle-left (much lighter ink), the binding-edge shadow at x450-600, the scan frame at x>3010, and the speck in col J.

proposal.page_topic: Domain officials and troop strength
proposal.page_summary_en: A fascicle-9 officials page carrying the tail of Tsurumaki Domain's roster and the whole of Tsuruga Domain's. On the right of the maru-marker, Tsurumaki closes with Aoki Kyūbee, the fifth of the five gon-daisanji whose first four names print on the facing recto, then shō-sanji 1 man (Ishii Bunzō), gon-shōsanji 5 men (Toyoda Shinzō, Obata Jihee, Honda Kaname, Ōtawa Bunpei, Seki Hajime), and troops 120 men. Left of the marker ○敦賀藩, Tsuruga lists nine officials by name with no head-counts and no troop line: daisanji Teramachi Shirōzaemon; gon-daisanji Teramachi Gennoshin and Hirayama Kotarō; shō-sanji Sanada Gorōzaemon, Nagata Shin and Tsuzuki Kichū, with a small-type note over Nagata's column recording a concurrent appointment as kōyō-yaku; gon-shōsanji Miura Tachū and Niwa Tsukumo; and a further shō-sanji, Katō Seiemon, whose two-column warichu reports that because he has been made house steward (karei) it is unclear whether he still holds the shō-sanji post.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The right-hand block prints no domain name of its own. The facing recto lower_p192_right.jpg (printed page 三百六十, header 藩制一覽表第九（鶴舞、鶴牧）) ends with the marker ○鶴牧藩 followed by 大參事 二人 and 權大參事 五人, under which only four names are set. The first column of this page, 靑木久兵衞, has no office label above it and completes that five, so the material right of the ○敦賀藩 marker is the continuation of 鶴牧藩's roster.
The maru-marker ○敦賀藩 at x1804-1890, y1338-1882 opens the block; the running header in the left margin reads 藩制一覽表第九（敦賀）, naming the same domain.

MARKERS AND OWNERSHIP. Two maru-markers print on this page: ○鶴舞藩 at x1892-1999 (y1343-1904) and ○鶴牧藩 at x827-933 (y1341-1899). Applying the right-to-left rule, everything RIGHT of ○鶴舞藩 belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything between the two markers belongs to 鶴舞藩; everything left of ○鶴牧藩 belongs to 鶴牧藩.

WHO IS THE PREVIOUS DOMAIN. Only one data column stands right of ○鶴舞藩 (x2038-2134 plus its note at x2008-2132). To identify its owner I opened the immediately preceding reading page, lower_p191_left: its running header reads 藩制一覽表第九（土浦）and its printed page number is 三百五十九 (359), one less than this page's 三百六十 (360). Its officials list runs to the left edge and its last column has the same shape as ours — a personal name followed by an office (奧田切瑳　大參事 there, 杉村克己　權大參事 here). The workspace bookmark index (HI_pdf_bookmark_index.csv) puts Vol2 fascicle 9 at 津藩 on pdf p.190 and 中津藩 on p.193, and gojūon order runs 津 → 土浦 → 鶴舞 → 鶴牧, which the running header （鶴舞、鶴牧）confirms. So the two right-hand items are 土浦藩's (Tsuchiura, Hitachi).

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
(1) x2183-2241, y1267-1952: running header 藩制一覽表第九（鶴舞、鶴牧）— provenance, not data.
(2) x2162-2213, y3108-3303: printed book page 三百六十 = 360 (bottom margin).
(3) x2047-2124, y1147-2049: 杉村克己 then 權大參事 — a name-then-office appointment entry closing 土浦藩's list.
(4) x2017-2124, y2155-3084: a two-run note. The ink profile across this band has a clear valley at x≈2074, splitting a right run (一色／杉村／赤尾／新／佐々, y2230-3084) from a left run (右依願被免本官候事, y2155-2800). Read right first, then the note: the five named men were relieved of office on their own petition. Owner 土浦藩.
(5) ○鶴舞藩 marker.
(6) x1773-1865: 大參事 (title y1002-1240) + 二人 (count y1435-1573); names below in the same column, 奧山脩 (y1756-2174) and 伏谷惇 (y2348-2762). 2 names = 二人.
(7) x1645-1734: 權大參事 + 四人; names 多川弘, 近藤寶, 安部井尙 fill the column (three), and the fourth wraps into the next column left, 坂主靜 at x1504-1588 with 公議人 printed under it in smaller type. 4 names = 四人.
(8) THE DOUBLED COUNT RUNS. Under 少參事 and 權少參事 two number runs print side by side: 二人 at x1387-1450 and a smaller 一人 at x1455-1503; 二人 at x1252-1314 and a smaller 四人 at x1319-1368. Measured widths are 62-63 px for the left members and 48-49 px for the right members, so the right members are set in smaller type. This is the same device already annotated on lower_p221_left (Akizuki), where 少參事 prints 五員 with a smaller （九員）to its right and nine names follow — the smaller figure is the corrected one. Here the smaller figures reconcile exactly with the names: 少參事 has one name (寺田豐哉) against the smaller 一人, and 權少參事 has four (山口均, 佐藤想內, 小出隣 in its own column, 屋代長 wrapped into the next column left at x1104-1187) against the smaller 四人. Each pair is boxed together with its title.
(9) x977-1067: 兵隊 (y1000-1152) with 七百三十九人 (y1347-1825) = 739 troops. It stands right of ○鶴牧藩, so it is 鶴舞藩's military, printed after its officials.
(10) ○鶴牧藩 marker, then 鶴牧藩: 大參事 二人 with 荒木左膳 and 豐田謙藏 (2 names = 2); 權大參事 五人 with 井上八郎右衞門, 本田新平 in its column and 山上左仲, 佐久間丈右衞門 wrapped into the leftmost column (x421-515). Only four of the five appear — the fifth continues onto lower_p192_left, which is where 鶴牧's block resumes.

ARITHMETIC CHECK. Name totals against printed/corrected counts: 鶴舞 大參事 2 = 2 ✓; 權大參事 4 = 4 ✓; 少參事 1 = corrected 1 ✓ (printed 2); 權少參事 4 = corrected 4 ✓ (printed 2). 鶴牧 大參事 2 = 2 ✓; 權大參事 4 of 5 on this page, remainder overleaf. Numerals verified at single-character zoom: 七百三十九 uses a plain cross 十, not 千; 五人 (not 三人) for 鶴牧's 權大參事; 九 (not 七) in 七百三十九.

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing was cross-checked against it; every value here is read off the scan.

GEOMETRY. All 30 boxes were cut by ink-projection (px<120, first..last inked row/column, 9 px pad) inside hand-set search regions, then machine-tested pairwise for overlap — zero overlaps. One overlay pass was rendered and read; no box clips a glyph, sits on whitespace, or touches a neighbour, so no second pass was needed.

proposal.page_header_en: Survey of Domain Institutions, Fascicle 9 (Tsurumai, Tsurumaki)
proposal.page_topic: Domain councillors and troop strength
proposal.page_summary_en: Printed page 360 of the Hansei Ichiran, fascicle 9, which records each domain's councillors and its troops. The right-hand column closes Tsuchiura domain's list with the appointment of Sugimura Katsumi as acting senior councillor and a note that Isshiki, Sugimura, Akao, Shin and Sasa were released from their offices on their own petition. Tsurumai domain (Kazusa) follows its marker with 2 senior councillors, 4 acting senior councillors, 1 junior councillor and 4 acting junior councillors — the junior figures printed as 2 and 2 and corrected in smaller type to 1 and 4, which is what the names show — and 739 troops; one of its acting senior councillors, Saka Shusei, also served as the domain's delegate to the Kōgisho. Tsurumaki domain opens at the left with 2 senior councillors and 5 acting senior councillors, four of whom are named before the page ends.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The only data column right of ○鶴舞藩 (x2038-2134) holds 杉村克己　權大參事 plus a dismissal note at x2008-2132. The immediately preceding reading page, lower_p191_left, is headed 藩制一覽表第九（土浦）and numbered 三百五十九 (359), one before this page's 三百六十 (360); its officials list runs to the page edge and ends in the same name-then-office form (奧田切瑳　大參事).
Its own maru-marker ○鶴牧藩 prints at x827-933, y1341-1899; everything left of it (大參事 二人, 權大參事 五人 and four names) is Tsurumaki's, and the running header names 鶴牧 as the page's second domain.

It stands to the right of the ○鶴舞藩 marker, so it belongs to the previous domain, whose officials list runs across the preceding page (p. 359, lower_p191_left) and ends there in the same form, 奧田切瑳　大參事.
verdicts.issue: Glyphs verified at 3x. Ownership verified independently: lower_p191_left is headed 藩制一覽表第九（土浦）and numbered 三百五十九, one before this page's 三百六十, and its final data column reads 奧田切瑳　大參事. verdicts.corrected_transcribing: 一色　杉村　赤尾　新　佐々　右依願被免本官候事
verdicts.issue: Warichu note. The column ink profile has a valley at x2073, splitting a right run (x2074-2123) from a left run (x2017-2073). Row runs in the right run give exactly nine glyph blocks: 一(2242-2251, one stroke) 色 杉 村 赤 尾 新 佐 々; the left run gives 右 依 願 被 免 本 官 候 事. Right run is read first, so the order as transcribed is correct. The two extra small runs the left-run profile showed at y2991-3022 are the 亻 of 佐 crossing the x2073 split, not separate glyphs (ink in y2985-3028 spans x2065-2112, one 48 px small-type glyph).
Zoomed 3x: circle, 鶴, 舞, 藩. Ink 1901-1990 / 1352-1895, box = ink + 9 px.

二 has two separate horizontal strokes; 人 closes at the apex (not 八 or 入). Two names follow in the same column (奧山脩 in slot 1 at y1756-2174, 伏谷惇 in slot 2 at y2348-2762, slot 3 empty), so 2 reconciles.

奧 and 山 are unambiguous at 5x. The third glyph was thresholded at 75 and 140 and enlarged 10x: 亻 at the left, a vertical, 攵 with its 乂 crossing at the upper right, and a 月 box with two internal bars at the lower right — 脩, not 備 (which would show ⺊ over 用 and no 乂). Reading Okuyama Osamu stays conjectural.
At 5x: 伏 (亻+犬), 谷, 惇 (忄+享). Second and last of the two 大參事.

四人 read at 2x and confirmed. Three names fill this column (多川弘, 近藤寶, 安部井尙 at slots y1757, y2347, y2934) and the fourth heads the next column to the left (坂主靜, x1504-1588, slot-1 y1754). 4 names against 四人.
At 4x: 多 / 川 / 弘. Glyph pitch 134 then 205 px — the wide second gap is the surname/given-name break, matching every other name column on this page.
Third glyph zoomed 9x: 宀 over a compressed 王/缶 band over 貝 with two legs — 寶, the kyujitai form.

verdicts.ident: 鶴舞權大參事安部井尙
verdicts.issue: Four glyphs at 4x: 安 部 井 尙, with pitch 86, 83, then 166 px — the three-character surname 安部井 compressed and 尙 after the break. Ink ends at y3336; the only mark below (y3387-3390, 3-4 px) is a speck, not a glyph.

At 4x: 坂 (土+反), then after a 143 px gap 主 and 靜 (靑+爭) 78 px apart, then 公 議 人 in smaller type. The name run measures 66 px wide and 公議人 52 px, and 公議人 sits centred under the name rather than in the right gutter, so it attaches to this man rather than being a separate heading. Column position confirms the assignment: it stands between the 權大參事 column (x1632-1724) and the 少參事 column (x1380-1502), so it continues the 權大參事 list.

Two side-by-side number runs verified by column profile: 二人 at x1387-1449 (63 px, aligned with the 少參事 title at x1390-1457) and a smaller 一人 at x1455-1502 (48 px), inserted in the right-hand gutter. Zoomed 7x — the left run has two horizontal strokes, the right run one. Row profile of x1452-1506 over y1350-1700 shows ink only at y1452-1462 and y1521-1563, so no parenthesis arcs print on this page; the same device on lower_p221_left (Akizuki, 少參事 五員（九員）) does print them. The parentheses in the transcription are therefore an editorial mark following the corpus convention, and the English says so. Only one name (寺田豐哉) stands under this heading before the next column, so the smaller figure is the true count and parsed 1 is right.

Four glyphs at 5x: 寺 田 豐 哉, evenly pitched at 110-116 px because four characters share one name slot. Slots 2 and 3 of this column are empty — the permissive ink sweep (threshold 175) found nothing there.

Ownership: the column stands to the right of ○鶴牧藩 (x827-933) and to the left of Tsurumai's last officials column, which is the fascicle-9 military-overflow position, so it belongs to Tsurumai.

謙 is 言+兼; the fourth glyph zoomed 9x shows 艹 over 臧 — 藏, the kyujitai form.

proposal.reasoning:
MARKERS AND OWNERSHIP. Two maru-markers on the leaf, both found by ink-projection and read at 2.2x-4x zoom. (1) circle+中+津+藩 at x2554-2660, y1327-1892: the circle sits at y1337-1416, 中 at 1450-1528, 津 at 1623-1704, 藩 at 1799-1882. This is the RIGHTMOST inked element on the page — a column projection over y900-3600 finds no ink at all between x2650 and x3064 — so nothing on this leaf belongs to the preceding domain, and Nakatsu's Fascicle 9 entry opens here. (2) circle+中+村+藩 at x1338-1445, y1337-1902. Everything between the two markers (x1471-2525) is 中津藩's; everything left of the ○中村藩 marker (x939-1297) is 中村藩's. The running header at the far left, 藩制一覽表第九（中津、中村）, is provenance and names both domains, which agrees with the two-domain split.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (native x; row bands from per-column ink projection).
x2554-2660: ○中津藩 marker.
x2433-2525: 官員 (y989-1076) over 不詳 (y1331-1496). Nakatsu returned no establishment headcount, which is why every rank label further left prints bare, with no 一人/二人 count under it — unlike lower_p221_right (Akashi), where each label carries its figure.
x2275-2401: 兵隊 (y994-1151) heading over TWO side-by-side runs. Projected separately: the right run (x2332-2400) holds exactly six glyphs at y1341,1411,1480,1547,1613,1684 = 士 千 五 十 九 人; the left run (x2272-2330) holds seven at y1341,1413,1479,1547,1614,1685,1754 = 卒 八 百 七 十 八 人. I zoomed the 2nd and 4th glyphs of the right run to 8x: the glyph at y1400-1460 has the slanted stroke sitting on top of the horizontal (千), and the glyph at y1540-1595 is a plain cross with no top slant (十). So the reading is 士千五十九人 = 1,059 and 卒八百七十八人 = 878; 1,059 + 878 = 1,937.
  MASTER DISAGREES AND THE SCAN WINS. MASTER's two rows for this page both read 士 二千五百七十九人 and parse the entry at 3,457 persons. 士二千五百七十九人 is nine glyphs; the printed run physically holds six, and the column is blank from y1151 down to y1341 above 士, so there is no room for a dropped 二 or 百. The correct figures are 1,059 shizoku and 878 sotsu, 1,937 in all — not 2,579 and 3,457. (An older hand-made annotation file for this same leaf, data/annotations/nakatsu_officials_military.json, also reads 士千五十九人, independently of my measurement.)
x2159-2250: 大參事 label, three glyphs only (y998-1246), no count.
x2139-2239: three name registers in the label column — y1583-2169 奧平惺學, y2257-2845 生田實, y2926-3515 山崎直衞. The register grid is fixed-height (~570 px) with the glyphs spread to fill it, which is how a 3-glyph name (生田實, pitch 250) and a 7-glyph name (菅沼新五右衞門, pitch 84) occupy the same band. I zoomed 實 to 8x: under 宀 there are two elements, 毌 over 貝 — 實, not 寳, which would stack 王+缶+貝.
x2014-2109: a label-less column continuing 大參事 — y1584-2169 逸見志馬, y2258-2844 桑名豐山. Per the Fascicle 9 convention (a label-less name column continues the office named to its right), Nakatsu shows five senior councillors.
x1878-1978: 權大參事 label, four glyphs (y998-1335), then 岡見半太夫 (y1584-2173), 奧平吉左衞門 (y2257-2841), 西尾次郎右衞門 (y2931-3517).
x1742-1839: label-less continuation — 猪飼太兵衞 (y1588-2175), 鈴木力兵衞 (y2260-2847).
x1606-1712: 少參事 label, three glyphs (y1000-1250), then 佐竹四郎左衞門 (y1586-2172), 牟禮源太郎 (y2259-2847), 菅沼新五右衞門 (y2934-3521).
x1471-1570: label-less continuation — 福田清兵衞 (y1589-2180), 日下田孫八 (y2266-2853).
x1338-1445: ○中村藩 marker.
x1205-1304: 大參事 label (y1002-1253) and one name, 泉田文庫 (y2006-2594). Nakamura's name registers sit lower on the leaf than Nakatsu's (y~2015 and y~2940 against y~1590/2265/2940).
x1064-1168: 權大參事 label (y1004-1341) with 大浦庄右衞門 (y2014-2601) and 岡部正藏 (y2937-3525).
x939-1036: 少參事 label (y1009-1259) with 多田部楯太郎 (y2016-2604). Nakamura's entry prints no 官員 line and no 兵隊 line here; its military must run on to the following leaf.
x822-900: running header 藩制一覽表第九（中津、中村）, y1265-1974. x810-885: printed page number 三百六十三 = 363, y3110-3376.

COMPLETENESS. A full-page ink sweep (interior x470-3050, y250-4300, threshold 120) returns row bands only at y999-2843 and y2937-3514 (the text), plus a single 8-px speck at y561-569 and the black scan border at y4218+. The speck is a scanning artifact, not a glyph, and is not boxed. There are no 但 subtexts, no warichu, and no editorial absence note other than 不詳. Nothing sits to the right of the ○中津藩 marker, so the right-of-marker overflow rule that governs vol.2 Fascicle 8/9 leaves never fires here.

GEOMETRY. Every box is a tight ink bbox (px<120) over its own region with 10 px pad. A pairwise test over all 31 boxes returns zero overlaps. One overlay pass rendered at 0.30 scale confirmed that no box clips a glyph, sits on whitespace, or touches a neighbour; the open gap on the right side of the ○中津藩 circle is broken ink in the print, not a clipped box (ink runs to x2650, the box to x2660). No box needed moving, so I did not render a second time.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The ○中村藩 maru-marker stands at x1338-1445, y1337-1902. The three rank columns to its left (大參事 at x1205-1304, 權大參事 at x1064-1168, 少參事 at x939-1036) and their four names are Nakamura's; the entry prints no 官員 or 兵隊 line on this leaf and runs on to the following one. proposal.page_topic: domain officials and troop strength
proposal.page_summary_en: Fascicle 9 of the 1870 Hansei Ichiran survey, opening Nakatsu Domain's entry and running into Nakamura's. Nakatsu returns 不詳 — "not detailed" — for the size of its official establishment, then reports 1,059 shizoku and 878 sotsu under arms, 1,937 men in all, and names fifteen councillors: five senior (dai-sanji), five acting senior (gon-dai-sanji) and five junior (shō-sanji), among them two men of the ruling Okudaira surname. Nakamura's block opens at the ○中村藩 marker and names one senior councillor (Izumida Bunko), two acting senior councillors (Ōura Shōzaemon and Okabe Shōzō) and one junior councillor (Tadabe Tatetarō), with its military figures carried over to the following leaf. The project dataset records Nakatsu's shizoku figure as 二千五百七十九人 (2,579); the printed column holds only six glyphs, 士千五十九人, so the figure is 1,059 and the domain total is 1,937 rather than 3,457.

proposal.reasoning:
RENDER + MARKER SURVEY. The scan is 3095x4489. A column ink-projection (px<120) over y=300..4200, x=150..2800 returns 14 vertical glyph runs plus the binding-edge black at x>2650 (excluded). Two maru-markers are present: ○鶴田藩 at x2006-2097, y1371-1913, and ○名古屋藩 at x1061-1148, y1379-1967.

RIGHT-TO-LEFT OWNERSHIP. Reading right to left, the only material to the RIGHT of the ○鶴田藩 marker is the running header (x2154-2206, y1288-2029) and the printed book-page number (x2146-2196, y3132-3373) — both page furniture, no data. So no previous domain overflows onto this page. Everything between the two markers (x1193-1965) belongs to 鶴田藩: the proofreader's note and six name columns carrying four office labels. Everything LEFT of ○名古屋藩 (x374-1020) belongs to 名古屋藩: four office-count columns and the 兵隊 block. The fascicle-8/9 overflow trap does not bite here — Nagoya's military prints at the far left, after its own officials, not to the right of a following marker.

COLUMN-BY-COLUMN WALK (right to left).
(1) x2154-2206, y1288-2029: 藩制一覽表第九（鶴田、名古屋）, the running header; provenance, naming both domains on the page.
(2) x2006-2097, y1371-1913: four glyph groups ○ / 鶴 / 田 / 藩 = the 鶴田藩 maru-marker.
(3) x1692-1955, y684-934: a five-sub-column small-type note above the Tsuruta office columns. Per-sub-column row projections give 5+5+5+4+2 glyphs: （校正者曰 / 重複ナルモ / 姓名記載ニ / 付省略セ / ス）= （校正者曰重複ナルモ姓名記載ニ付省略セス）.
(4) x1872-1950: label 大參事 (y1041-1268) then two names, 尾關秀 (y2045-2612) and 伊藤三郎 (y2966-3531).
(5) x1734-1813: 權大參事 (y1043-1355) + 野島亨, 河鰭新. The second glyph of the lower name was checked at 7x and by IoU against 鰭/鯖/鮨 — 鰭 wins (0.412); 河鰭 is a known court-noble surname.
(6) x1601-1678: 少參事 (y1044-1270) + 寺田與, 河村弘.
(7) x1470-1538: NO office label — the row projection over y250-2045 in this x-window is empty; the column holds one name only, 岡尾靖 (y2045-2611). It continues the 少參事 list from column (6).
(8) x1332-1411: 權少參事 (y1042-1357) + 與津實, 岡村郡太.
(9) x1203-1272: NO office label; two names, 服部傳 and 伊藤篤藏. Continues the 權少參事 list.
(10) x1061-1148: ○名古屋藩 marker, five glyph groups.
(11) x939-1010: 大參事 (y1042-1272) 二人. (12) x805-876: 權大參事 六人 — the numeral has a top lid, so 六 and not 八. (13) x671-742: 少參事 五人. (14) x537-605: 權少參事 十一人.
(15) x405-469, y1044-1191: 兵隊, a two-glyph heading with no number of its own; is_data is false because nothing is printed against it. Below it, one merged ink run x386-488 splits at its profile minimum x=436 (value 7, against 205 at x423 and 130 at x444) into two sub-columns sharing the top y1371: 士族兵二千四百八十人 on the right (x433-493) and 卒族兵四千七百二十人 on the left (x374-432).

GLYPH CHECKS. 與 vs 興 in 寺田與 and 與津實: both glyphs were binarized, blown up 9x, and set beside 與 and 興 rendered from Yu Mincho Demibold and MS Gothic at 78 px. 興's central 同 prints as one tall white rectangle in the middle column; neither scan glyph has it — the centre is solid black with the white cells only in the left and right claws, which is 與. For the last glyph of 伊藤篤藏, a wide grass-radical bar across the top rules out the left-right compositions 職/識/織 (IoU also ranks 藏 first at 0.382), and 篤藏 is a standard Meiji given name.

ARITHMETIC. Tsuruta's rosters give 2 大參事 + 2 權大參事 + 3 少參事 (2 in the labelled column, 1 in the continuation) + 4 權少參事 (2 + 2) = 11 men. That reproduces exactly the counts MASTER already holds for 鶴田藩 from fascicle 8 at lower p183 — 大参事 2, 権大参事 2, 少参事 3, 権少参事 4 — which independently confirms both the office-to-column assignment and the proofreader's statement that this page duplicates an earlier entry. Nagoya's officials total 2+6+5+11 = 24. Troops: 2,480 + 4,720 = 7,200; no printed total exists to check that against, so 7,200 appears only in the summary and in no box's parsed field. Numerals re-read at single-character size: 二千四百八十 has 八 (strokes splayed, no lid) and 十 (plain cross, no slanted top); 四千七百二十 has 七 (horizontal plus L-hook, not 九).

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER holds no rows keyed to lower p193, so every value here is new. Its Tsuruta fascicle-8 counts agree with this page as set out above.

GEOMETRY. Every box was measured by ink projection with about 10 px of pad. The verifier reports 0 box-box overlaps and 24 px of ink outside all boxes, in three isolated specks (x300-329 y2400-2459; x979-981 y2543-2546; x2080-2160 y2820-2900) that are dust, not glyphs. The only boxes with ink on a border are the two troop sub-columns, which abut at x432/433 — the standard shared-boundary case for a side-by-side split.

proposal.page_header_en: Han System Overview Table, Fascicle 9 (Tsuruta, Nagoya)
proposal.page_topic: Domain officials by name and by count, plus Nagoya's troop strength
proposal.page_summary_en: This right-hand page of fascicle 9, printed book page 362, records the officials of two domains. Tsuruta's are given by name: two daisanji (Ozeki Shū, Itō Saburō), two gon-daisanji (Nojima Tōru, Kawabata Shin), three shōsanji (Terada Yo, Kawamura Hiroshi, Okao Yasushi) and four gon-shōsanji (Yotsu Minoru, Okamura Gunta, Hattori Tsutae, Itō Tokuzō) — eleven men, matching the 2/2/3/4 counts already recorded for Tsuruta in fascicle 8. Nagoya's are given only as counts — 2 daisanji, 6 gon-daisanji, 5 shōsanji, 11 gon-shōsanji, 24 in all — followed by its troop strength of 2,480 shizoku soldiers and 4,720 sotsu soldiers, 7,200 together. A proofreader's note at the head of the Tsuruta block explains that the compilers kept this entry even though it duplicates an earlier one, because it records the personal names.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The ○名古屋藩 maru-marker sits at x1061-1148, y1379-1967. The four office-count columns (大參事 二人 at x939-1010 through 權少參事 十一人 at x537-605) and the 兵隊 block (x374-493) all lie to its left, so all of them belong to Nagoya. Nothing of Nagoya's spills to the right of the marker.

proposal.reasoning:
MEASUREMENT METHOD. Scan is 3094x4489. One ink-projection (px<120) over the paper interior x600-2950, y600-4200 returned 14 clean vertical glyph runs; a per-column row projection then gave every element's top/bottom. All boxes below come from those measurements plus ~8px pad; a programmatic pairwise overlap test on the final 19 boxes reports zero overlaps.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (a column is one vertical glyph run; rightmost is read first).
C1 x2611-2682: 大參事 (label y1001-1232) + 石原定安 (y1671-2236) + 青山直道 (y2590-3154).
C2 x2478-2548: 權大參事 + 土岐正紀 + 棚橋朝成; a tie-hook prints under 成 at y3165-3185 and runs left to the note in C3's foot.
C3 x2344-2464: 少參事 + 曾我祜申 + 水野忠鼎. A half-width parenthetical （一ニ小池煒）prints alongside 曾 at x2417-2465, y1453-1813 (a column ink profile across y1670-1740 shows a clean white gap at x2414-2416 separating 曾, which ends at 2413, from the note, which starts at 2417). A second parenthetical, two-sub-column warichu prints below 鼎 at y3180-3649.
C4 x2211-2285: 權少參事 + 土岐正武 + 中根清償. A tie line at y2277-2283 runs from under 武 leftwards to x2060.
C5 x2081-2148: NO label — a continuation column of 權少參事, holding 塚本忠安 + 藤田政治. (Confirmed: the row projection for C5 shows nothing in the label band y1000-1330.)
C6 x1928-2030: 兵隊 一小隊 (label+value y1006-1570) and, at y2279-3266, the two-sub-column parenthetical that the C4 tie line points to.
C7 x1797-1896: 生兵 五十人 (y1009-1568) then a two-sub-column warichu y1594-2177.
C8 x1670-1754: MARU-MARKER ○七日市藩, y1345-1933.
C9 x1553-1623: 大參事 + 海野三治.
C10 x1415-1489: 權大參事 + 横尾随翁 (y2020-2585) + 森諷齋 (y2941-3506).
C11 x1286-1352: NO label — continuation column of 權大參事, holding 保坂一於里.
C12 x1153-1222: 公議人 + 海野三雄.
C13 x1021-1089: 少參事 + 齋藤寛. (Zoomed both labels at 4x to be sure: 公議人 really does print to the RIGHT of 少參事 here, i.e. before it in reading order. That inverts the usual fascicle-9 rank order; I recorded what is printed.)
C14 x900-960: outer-margin furniture only — running header 藩制一覽表第九（七日市）at y1273-1880 and the printed page number 三百六十七 at y3116-3362.

OWNERSHIP (right-to-left marker rule). There is exactly ONE maru-marker on the page, ○七日市藩 in C8. Everything to its RIGHT (C1-C7) therefore belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything to its LEFT (C9-C13) belongs to 七日市藩.

WHICH previous domain. I opened the preceding page, lower_p195_right (book page 三百六十六). Its running header reads 藩制一覽表第九（成羽、苗木）and its last marker is ○苗木藩, printed at the far left of that page with 兵隊 不詳 (belonging to 成羽藩) to its right. So the domain running into our page is 苗木藩 (Naegi, Mino, Tōyama house). Two independent confirmations: 青山直道, printed here as 大參事, is the Naegi 大参事 known from the domain's 1870-71 haibutsu-kishaku episode; and 棚橋 is a Mino surname. The project's HI_pdf_bookmark_index.csv lists 長島藩 at pdf_page 195 and 七日市藩 at 196 and names neither 成羽 nor 苗木 — the scan disagrees with that index and I followed the scan. MASTER holds no rows for this page; its 195 R row (長島藩 兵隊 二百十五人, noted "right of ○成羽") is consistent with the page image and is not in conflict.

MILITARY OVERFLOW. C6 兵隊 一小隊 and C7 生兵 五十人 sit to the RIGHT of the ○七日市藩 marker, so by the fascicle 8-9 overflow rule they are 苗木藩's military, printed after 苗木's officials. 七日市藩's own troop figure is not on this page; it prints on lower_p196_right (MASTER: 兵隊 藩士四十三人 兵卒八十一人 = 124).

EDITORIAL (校異) NOTES — three of them, all compiler's variant-reading notes, all owned by 苗木藩.
(a) （一ニ小池煒）, printed beside 曾 in C3: "one copy has Koike I". Read at 8-10x; the fourth glyph is 火 + a right component with a boxed middle and a long descender, read as 煒 — the type is small warichu and this single glyph is the least certain reading on the page.
(b) The C3-foot parenthetical: right sub-column 一ニ宮地貴巳, left sub-column トシ土岐ナシ, i.e. 「一ニ宮地貴巳トシ土岐ナシ」— "one copy reads Miyaji Takami, with no Toki". Its tie line springs from under 成 in C2 and so annotates the C2 entry, whose first name is 土岐正紀.
(c) The C6 parenthetical: right sub-column 一ニ宮地正武トアリ土岐ナシ, left sub-column 右留守官届書午三月届 — "one copy has Miyaji Masatake, with no Toki" plus the provenance line "the foregoing is from the resident-officer's report, filed in the third month of the horse year" (Meiji 3 = 庚午, 1870). A zoom of the tie line at 3x shows it running from directly under 武 (土岐正武, C4) leftwards into this note, so part (c) annotates 土岐正武.

GLYPH CHECKS at single-character magnification: 祜 in 曾我祜申 (left radical is the kyūjitai 示 with 二 over 小, right side is 古 with a straight cross over 口 — not 右, so 祜 not 祐); 申 (vertical pierces the box above and below — not 甲); 償 (亻+賞) in 中根清償; the middle glyph of 森諷齋 (言 + an outer frame enclosing a 口 over strokes, read 風, hence 諷 not 謳). Page number 三百六十七 = 367 read at 5x.

ARITHMETIC NET: not applicable. This is a fascicle-9 officials-and-troops page; it prints no demographic totals, no 男/女 split, no koku sums, and no component groups. The only quantities are 一小隊 (one company) and 五十人 (fifty men), neither of which is a total over printed parts.

BOX POLICY. One box per printed column, enclosing the office label together with every name in that column, since that is how the page organizes the entry. The three parenthetical notes and the 生兵 warichu each get their own box. The two hairline tie/connector rules are left unboxed — they are rules, not glyphs. Nothing else on the page is unboxed; the faint marks in the lower field are facing-page bleed-through and specks, and the black edges are the scan frame.

proposal.page_header_en: Han Administration Survey, Fascicle 9 (Nanokaichi)
proposal.page_topic: Domain officials and troop strength
proposal.page_summary_en: This page of fascicle 9 carries the close of the Naegi (苗木) domain entry and the opening of the Nanokaichi (七日市) entry, the two divided by the maru-marker ○七日市藩 in the middle of the page. Naegi's returns list ten office-holders — two 大參事 (Ishihara Sadayasu, Aoyama Naomichi), two 權大參事 (Toki Masanori, Tanahashi Tomonari), two 少參事 (Soga Koshin, Mizuno Tadakane) and four 權少參事 (Toki Masatake, Nakane Kiyoyasu, Tsukamoto Tadayasu, Fujita Masaharu) — followed by a force of one company (一小隊) plus fifty raw recruits (生兵五十人), the recruits noted as picked men added to the ranks with a view to forming a second company. Nanokaichi, a 10,000-koku house, returns only five men: one 大參事 (Unno Sanji), three 權大參事 (Yokoo Zuio, Mori Fusai, Hosaka Kazuori), one 公議人 (Unno Mitsuo) and one 少參事 (Saito Kan), with no troop figure on this page. Three compiler's notes flag variant readings in a second manuscript copy, twice substituting the surname Miyaji (宮地) for Toki (土岐), and one of them dates the Naegi return to the third month of the horse year (Meiji 3, 1870) from the resident officer's report.

neighbour_domains.evidence: No maru-marker precedes columns C1-C7 on this page, so they continue the domain last marked. The preceding page lower_p195_right (book page 366) has the running header 藩制一覽表第九（成羽、苗木）and ends with the marker ○苗木藩; its 兵隊 不詳 column sits to the right of that marker and belongs to 成羽藩. Confirmed independently by 青山直道, the Naegi 大参事 of 1870-71, appearing in C1.

proposal.reasoning:
MEASUREMENT. Scan is 3094x4489. Paper bounds by brightness (>170, >800 px per row/col): rows 205-4220, cols 446-3093; the surrounding black is scan frame and was excluded. Ink projection (px<120) over x480-3085, y240-4190 returned 15 text columns plus the right-edge binding dark. Right to left: C1 x2636-2713, C2 2488-2581, C3 2355-2444, C4 2206-2313, C5 2073-2160, C6 1936-2045, C7 1818-1912, C8 1704-1782, C9 1557-1647, C10 1436-1508, C11 1306-1376, C12 1175-1242, C13 1019-1122, C14 891-970. One 10-px-wide run at x1402-1411 (peak 8 inked px) is a speck, not a glyph, and was not boxed. A leftover-ink sweep after masking all 22 boxes left three clusters: x2502-2517 / y2801-2818 (a 16x18 px ink dot), and two faint runs at x2574-2581 / y1148-1158 and x2511-2523 / y1202-1289 whose darkest pixel is 59-65 against 25 for real type - facing-page bleed-through. None boxed.

MARKERS AND OWNERSHIP. Two maru-markers: circle + name + han at C2 (x2488-2578, y1354-1897) reading O-mura-matsu-han, and at C9 (x1557-1648, y1345-1882) reading O-mura-oka-han. Both print the ordinary form of mura (tree radical + sun), NOT the variant form used for Muraoka elsewhere in the survey. Applying the right-to-left rule: C1, standing to the RIGHT of the Muramatsu marker, belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; C3-C8, left of that marker and right of the Muraoka marker, are Muramatsu's; C10-C13, left of the Muraoka marker, are Muraoka's.

WHO THE PREVIOUS DOMAIN IS. C1 reads "unincorporated troops, three platoons, sixty men to the platoon" - military, and fascicle 9 prints military after officials, so it is the previous domain's overflow. I opened the facing leaf lower_p196_right in this session: its running header reads Fascicle 9 (Murakami), its printed page number is 368, and its last three columns are troops two platoons / sixty men to the platoon, staff officers 32, buglers 8. So C1 continues Murakami's military return and is owned by Murakami. MASTER holds no rows for this leaf, so nothing here could be cross-checked against it; the neighbour identification rests on the facing scan, which I read directly.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT. C1 (Murakami) unincorporated troops, 3 platoons at 60 = 180 men. C2 Muramatsu marker. C3 senior councillor, 1 post, name Kondo Yasugoro below. C4 acting senior councillor, 4 posts, names Matsui Shitomi (upper slot) and Noguchi Daikichi (lower slot). C5 has NO heading - its ink begins only at y2010, in the name band - so it is a continuation column of the C4 roster, holding Kojima Izumi (upper) and the two-character name 治運 (lower). C6 junior councillor, 2 posts, names Kano Yoichi and Ono Tadami. C7 acting junior councillor, 1 post, name Kodama Shusuke. C8 troops 1,102. C9 Muraoka marker. C10 senior councillor 1. C11 acting senior councillor 3. C12 full-and-acting junior councillor 2. C13 troops, with a two-run warichu split: the column ink profile over y1390-1800 has its minimum at x1070-1071 (8-9 px against 80-150 either side), so the right run is x1072-1122 (shizoku 40 men) and the left run x1019-1070 (sotsu 60 men); the heading straddles both at x1042-1109, so, following the same-fascicle precedent on the facing leaf, heading and both runs are one box. C14 running header and, far below it, the printed page number.

ARITHMETIC NET. Muramatsu's posts sum to 1+4+2+1 = 8, and the printed names number 8 (Kondo; Matsui, Noguchi, Kojima, 治運; Kano, Ono; Kodama). That reconciliation is what settles C5's ownership: without the two names in the unheaded column the acting-senior-councillor count of 4 would be short by two. Muraoka's troops: 40 shizoku + 60 sotsu = 100. Murakami's overflow: 3 x 60 = 180. Every numeral was checked at single-character zoom for the look-alike traps - the 1,102 leads with sen (slanted stroke sitting on top of the cross), not ju; the 40/60 pair in the warichu is shi / roku, roku showing its top lid; the tallies end in nin (strokes touching at the apex), not hachi.

GEOMETRY. Each box was measured by ink projection (px<110) inside its own region, then padded 8 px on each side. Minimum horizontal gap between adjacent tight boxes is 43 px, so no padded box touches another; a programmatic pairwise intersection test over all 22 padded boxes reported no overlaps. One overlay render was inspected at 1137x1350; every box encloses its glyph run top to bottom with no clipping and none sits on whitespace, so no correction pass was needed.

The facing leaf lower_p196_right prints the running header 藩制一覽表第九（村上）, the book-page number 三百六十八, and ends with 兵隊　二小隊　一隊六十人 / 役員　三十二人 / 喇叭手　八人 — this column continues that same military return.

The leaf opens with the last column of Murakami Domain's military return — 未編制兵隊　三小隊　一隊六十人, three unincorporated platoons of sixty men each, 180 men in all — which continues from the facing leaf (printed page 368). The ○村松藩 marker then opens Muramatsu Domain (Echigo), which records eight council posts: one 大參事 (近藤安五郎), four 權大參事 (松井蔀, 野口大吉, 兒島泉 and 治運, the roster running on into a column with no heading of its own), two 少參事 (狩野與一, 小野但見) and one 權少參事 (小玉收輔); posts and printed names both come to eight, and its troops number 千百二人, 1,102 men. proposal.reasoning:
MEASUREMENT METHOD. Native scan 3094x4489. Paper interior measured by brightness threshold = cols 447..3076, rows 194..4211 (scan-frame black excluded). Ink projection (px<120) inside that interior gave three horizontal registers: an office/count register y≈992..1924, a first name register y≈1991..2569, and a second name register y≈2912..3490. Column runs were then projected separately inside each register, which is what separated the office columns from the name columns (a single whole-page projection merged them).

MARU-MARKERS AND THE RIGHT-TO-LEFT RULE. Two maru-markers on the page. The rightmost column of the whole page (x 2622..2712) is ○臼杵藩; nothing at all is printed to its right, so no previous-domain overflow is present on this leaf and the page OPENS with Usuki. The second marker ○上田藩 sits at x 1561..1652. By the right-to-left rule everything between the two markers (i.e. to the RIGHT of ○上田藩) belongs to 臼杵藩 — that is the four councillor-grade columns, the 兵員 column, and all nine Usuki name columns. Everything to the LEFT of ○上田藩 belongs to 上田藩. owner_domain_jp is set on every box on that basis. The running header 藩制一覽表第九（臼杵、上田）names both domains, so header provenance and data ownership agree here.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (office/count register). x2622-2712 ○臼杵藩 marker; x2500-2573 大參事 一人; x2371-2441 權大參事 二人; x2241-2311 少參事 三人; x1976-2048 權少參事 三人; x1710-1784 兵員 九百人; x1561-1652 ○上田藩 marker; x1442-1516 大參事 一人; x1310-1382 權大參事 三人; x1045-1115 少參事 五人; x917-977 running header. The faint gray glyphs around x2050-2200 and x1600-1700 in the office register are facing-page bleed-through (much lighter ink, no run above the projection threshold) and are NOT boxed; four small ink specks (near x2317 y1670, x2317 y1863, x2465 y1318, x2200 y1371) are likewise left unboxed.

NAME COLUMNS. Personal names print in two lower registers. Name register 1 columns (right to left): 2487-2554 片岡秀重, 2355-2422 粟屋勝孝, 2225-2295 加納孝, 2094-2165 岡部章, 1957-2030 清水濯纓, 1825-1899 橘朴, then (after the Ueda marker's block) 1420-1493 師岡主鈴, 1289-1363 藤井淡水, 1154-1227 瀧澤省吾, 1023-1095 大島齋. Name register 2 columns: 2345-2413 村瀨十應, 2212-2282 後藤鈍臣, 1941-2015 若林永與, 1275-1341 山口平太郎, 1007-1079 久松新五左衞門. Each name-register-2 column sits 9-19 px left of its name-register-1 partner, i.e. the two are one column block read top-to-bottom, then the next block to the left.

ASSIGNING NAMES TO POSTS (arithmetic net). Usuki declares 1+2+3+3 = 9 officeholders and exactly 9 Usuki name columns are printed, so the roster is complete for Usuki. Reading order (column top-to-bottom, then next column left) gives: 大參事 (1) = 片岡秀重; 權大參事 (2) = 粟屋勝孝, 村瀨十應; 少參事 (3) = 加納孝, 後藤鈍臣, 岡部章; 權少參事 (3) = 清水濯纓, 若林永與, 橘朴. Ueda declares 1+3+5 = 9 but only 6 Ueda names are printed before the leaf ends at the header column: 大參事 (1) = 師岡主鈴; 權大參事 (3) = 藤井淡水, 山口平太郎, 瀧澤省吾; 少參事 (5) = 大島齋, 久松新五左衞門 and three further names that must continue on the next leaf. That shortfall is stated here rather than silently absorbed.

GLYPH CHECKS AT SINGLE-CHARACTER MAGNIFICATION. 兵員 九百人 = 900: 九 has the rounded bending leg (not 七), 百 is 一 over 白, and the final glyph's two strokes touch at the apex = 人, not 八. Every count glyph 一/二/三/五 was checked as a plain horizontal stack; 五 (Ueda 少參事) shows the closed Z-turn, so it is not 三. Blank-slot check by per-cell ink sum confirmed three-character names where the third row is empty: 加納孝 (row-3 ink = 0), 岡部章 (0), 大島齋 (0), and 橘朴 (rows 2 and 3 both = 0). 村瀨's second glyph zoomed at 10x shows 氵 + 束 + 頁, so it is the kyūjitai 瀨, not 瀬; its third glyph is a plain cross 十 with no slanted top stroke, so not 千. Its fourth glyph, zoomed to a single character at 8-10x, has 广 (dot plus long down-left sweep) over 亻 on the left and a 隹 with stacked horizontal bars on the right, and a bottom of left-dot + rising hooked curve + two interior dots = 心, not 灬; that gives 應 (not 鷹, which would end in 鳥). 若林's fourth glyph shows 与 inside the 舁 frame, so 與 and not 興. 大島's third glyph shows 亠, splayed side strokes and an inner 示, so 齋 and not 齊. The printed book-page number was zoomed at 8x: 三百七十一 = 371 (七 with hook, then a plain 十).

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. The task supplied no MASTER rows and no fascicle/table value for this page, so nothing was available to reconcile against; every reading above comes from the scan itself. table_number 9 is taken from the running header's own 第九.

BOX GEOMETRY. Each box was measured by projecting ink inside a rough column window, taking first..last inked row and column, and padding 8 px, so an office box runs from the top of the title glyph to the bottom of the final 人. A programmatic pairwise test reports zero overlaps among all 27 boxes. Two overlay passes were rendered to _final.png and read; the only change between them was widening the page-number box from 66x242 to 70x250.

proposal.page_summary_en: A fascicle-9 officials leaf opening the entry for Usuki domain and running straight into Ueda domain. Usuki reports four councillor grades — 1 senior councillor (大參事), 2 acting senior councillors (權大參事), 3 junior councillors (少參事) and 3 acting junior councillors (權少參事), nine posts in all — together with a troop strength of 900 men (兵員 九百人), and prints exactly nine personal names, one per post, headed by the senior councillor Kataoka Hideshige. Ueda's block begins to the left of its own maru-marker with 1 senior councillor, 3 acting senior councillors and 5 junior councillors, nine posts, but only six names fit before the leaf ends, so three junior-councillor names continue on the following leaf. Ueda's entry carries no troop figure on this page.

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN 3094x4489. Ink-projection across the text band (x 700-2750, y 600-3600) resolves exactly 14 vertical glyph runs, read RIGHT to LEFT: C1 x2570-2644, C2 x2440-2512, C3 x2293-2381, C4 x2172-2241, C5 x2038-2110, C6 x1904-1977, C7 x1774-1843, C8 x1645-1708, C9 x1510-1581, C10 x1372-1443, C11 x1241-1313, C12 x1096-1170, C13 x965-1036, C14 x829-903 (the outer-margin column, holding the running header high on the page and the printed page number far below it).

MARU-MARKER: exactly ONE maru-marker on the page, at C3 (x2293-2381, y1372-1922), reading maru + 小諸藩. By the right-to-left rule everything RIGHT of it (C1, C2) was read EARLIER and belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything LEFT of it (C4 through C13) belongs to 小諸藩.

WHO IS THE PREVIOUS DOMAIN: I opened the facing page image lower_p218_right.jpg in this session. Its running header prints 藩制一覽表第九（古河）, its printed page number is 四百十二 (412), it carries a maru + 古河藩 marker with 知事一人 / 大參事二人 / 權大參事六人 / 少參事三人 / 權少參事 and a long roster of official names, and its LEFTMOST column is the bare heading 兵隊 with NO numbers under it. The numbers that heading demands are precisely C1 and C2 on this page. That is the fascicle-8/9 pattern: a domain's military prints after its officials and overflows right of the NEXT domain's marker. So owner_domain_jp for C1 and C2 = 古河藩; for everything else = 小諸藩. Printed page numbers 412 (right) then 413 (left) confirm the reading order.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT:
C1 拾二小隊　五百七拾六人　一小隊役員トモ五拾六人 (Koga). Read at 2x; the run is one column, the trailing note set in a smaller face at the same x-centre, so one box y1039-2699.
C2 礮隊四組　二拾八人　一組役員トモ九人 (Koga). First glyph checked as 礮 (石 + 敫), not 砲.
C3 maru + 小　諸　藩 — the domain-block marker, not data.
C4 知事　一人; C5 大參事　二人; C6 權大參事　一人; C7 少參事　二人. All four read from one 3x crop of x1760-2260, y1000-1660; the 參 glyphs show the kyujitai 厽-over-彡 form. The counting glyph 人 in each has strokes TOUCHING at the apex (人), not splayed (八).
C8 兵隊 — section heading for Komoro's force, no value.
C9 二小隊　百二十名　一小隊役員トモ八十一人. The 八 in 八十一 has separate splayed top strokes, so 81 not 61.
C10 役員　四十二名. C11 合百六十二名. C12 砲兵隊　四斤施條炮二門 — note the two different graphs, 砲 (石偏) in the corps name and 炮 (火偏, verified at 9x on a single-character crop, x1080-1190 y1690-1800) in the gun count. C13 人夫トモ二十六人.
C14 藩制一覽表第九（小諸） running header, and separately 四百十三 (413) as the printed book-page number about 1300px below it — two boxes, not one.

ARITHMETIC NET, both domains reconcile:
Komoro — 二小隊 120名 rank-and-file + 役員 42名 = 162名, matching 合百六十二名 exactly. Cross-check on the platoon note: 162 / 2 platoons = 81, matching 一小隊役員トモ八十一人. Both hold, so 八十一 is confirmed by arithmetic as well as by glyph shape.
Koga — 576人 / 12 platoons = 48 rank-and-file per platoon; 一小隊役員トモ五拾六人 implies 8 officers per platoon and 12 x 56 = 672 all ranks. Artillery: 28人 / 4 組 = 7 per battery; 一組役員トモ九人 implies 2 officers per battery, 4 x 9 = 36 all ranks. Both consistent (the "officers included" figure exceeds the bare count by a constant per unit).

NOT BOXED: the much fainter facing-page bleed-through visible in the lower half of the sheet, the binding-edge black at the page margins, and two isolated specks the row projection picked up at y2937-2957 in C6's column and y3466-3474 in C2's column.

GEOMETRY: each box measured by cropping a generous region, thresholding px<120, projecting onto rows and columns, taking first..last inked index, then padding 10px. Adjacent column gaps run 52-71px, so a 10px pad on each side leaves every pair of neighbours separated; the overlay render at _final.png confirms no box overlaps another, none clips a glyph, and none sits on whitespace, so one overlay pass was enough.

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing here is copied from the dataset; every value is read off the scan.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The facing right-hand page lower_p218_right.jpg prints the running header 藩制一覽表第九（古河）, page number 四百十二 (412), a maru + 古河藩 marker with Koga's officials and name roster, and ends on a bare 兵隊 heading with no figures beneath it. The two columns right of this page's maru + 小諸藩 marker (拾二小隊　五百七拾六人 and 礮隊四組　二拾八人) supply exactly those missing figures, so they are Koga's military overflow.

proposal.page_topic: Komoro domain officials and armed forces
proposal.page_summary_en: Fascicle nine of the 1870 Hansei ichiran survey records each domain's officials and its armed forces. This left-hand leaf, printed page 413, opens with two columns of troop figures that finish Koga domain's entry from the facing page: twelve platoons totalling 576 men, reckoned at 56 men per platoon with officers included, and four artillery batteries totalling 28 men, at 9 men per battery with officers included. The maru + 小諸藩 marker then begins Komoro domain, which reports one governor, two senior councillors, one acting senior councillor and two junior councillors. proposal.reasoning:
SCAN 3095x4489. Measurement method: ink projection at threshold <100–130 with the page's speckle baseline (~85 dark px per full-height column) subtracted; every box below was cut from a per-region row/column projection with ~9 px pad, and a programmatic pairwise rectangle-intersection test over all 27 boxes reported zero overlaps.

MARU-MARKERS. Exactly ONE maru-marker on the leaf: ○古河藩, measured at x2072–2155, y1344–1902 (○ y1353–1430, 古 y1459–1536, 河 y1642–1715, 藩 y1811–1893). Right-to-left rule: everything LEFT of that marker is Koga's; anything RIGHT of it would belong to the previous domain. Right of the marker there are only two ink columns on the whole leaf — the running header at x2213–2286 (y1262–1840) and the printed book-page number at x2185–2250 (y3107–3312) — and both are page furniture, not domain data. So there is NO previous-domain overflow on this leaf and neighbour_domains is empty. (The preceding fascicle-9 leaf, lower_p217_left, is the 郡山藩 marker page and carries 吹上藩's tail; Koga's own block starts clean here.)

RUNNING HEADER = PROVENANCE. 藩制一覽表第九（古河）, read at 3.5x: it names fascicle 9 and Koga, and here it agrees with the data on the page.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT. Head band (office labels with their establishment figures, y~1000–1585; the box encloses label glyphs down through the count glyphs, matching the convention used on the facing fascicle-9 leaves):
 x2213 header · x2185 book page 四百十二 (read at 4x: 四/百/十 plain cross, not 千/二) · x2072 ○古河藩 · x1955 知事 一人 · x1827 大參事 二人 · x1690 權大參事 六人 · x1293 少參事 三人 · x1029 權少參事 (crop of x420–1140, y980–1800 at 1.7x confirms NO figure is printed under it — the slot is blank) · x483 兵隊, a bare two-glyph heading set one glyph-slot lower than the office line, with nothing below it; Koga's troop figures continue on the facing leaf.

Name registers. There are TWO name registers, an upper one at y~1990–2600 and a lower one at y~2930–3530, and ten column positions. Ten entries print in the upper register and eight in the lower (the x1148 and x607 columns have no lower entry — verified by projection, both come back EMPTY).

WHO HOLDS WHAT. The office heading stands at the head of its own column, and its holders fill that column's upper slot, then its lower slot, then the next column left, and so on until the printed count is met; the next heading then starts at the next column left. Three independent checks confirm this alignment rather than any one-column offset: (1) 少參事 三人 heads x1293, and its group is x1274 upper (小杉平馬), x1258 lower (岩崎和多理), x1148 upper (菊地勘左衞門) — exactly three, and the x1148 LOWER slot is empty, which is what a three-man group leaves behind; (2) 權大參事 六人 heads x1690 and fills x1671/x1659, x1536/x1519, x1409/x1392 — exactly six; (3) 大參事 二人 heads x1827 and fills x1803 upper and x1787 lower — exactly two. The same heading↔name column alignment (heading x2027 → names x2018 upper, x2003 lower, a 10–20 px leftward drift from glyph shape) is what the already-annotated facing leaf lower_p217_right shows for 權大參事 二人 = 岩本範治 / 森岡隼太.

ARITHMETIC NET. Printed establishment figures 1 + 2 + 6 + 3 = 12. Names actually printed = 18. The 知事 column (x1955) has no name in either register, so the governor is unnamed; 2 go to 大參事, 6 to 權大參事, 3 to 少參事, leaving 18 − 11 = 7 for 權少參事 — which is exactly the seven entries from x1010 leftward (x1010/x994, x879/x862, x738/x724, x607 upper, x607 lower empty). So the unprinted 權少參事 establishment is 7 men.

TWO NOTATIONS TO RECORD. (a) The two 大參事 entries print a surname and then the office title in full type — 土井大參事 and 小杉大參事 — with no given name; single-character zoom at 7x confirms 大 / 參 / 事 in both. (b) The six 權大參事 entries print a surname (and, in the first, the extra character 權, confirmed at 7x) and then a long printed vertical rule running down the remaining glyph slots — 來次權—, 朝倉—, 潮田—, 藤懸—, 鈴木—, 恩田—. The rule is the compositor's mark for name slots the domain did not fill; its extent was measured separately with a min-per-row scan (e.g. 朝倉's rule runs y3250–3515, 藤懸's y3200–3508, 恩田's y3110–3510) because a thin rule falls under the ordinary projection threshold. Where the source gives full names — 少參事 and 權少參事 — no rule appears.

CROSS-CHECK AGAINST MASTER. MASTER holds no rows at all for lower p218 R, and its 古河藩 rows are all fascicle-6 civil/fiscal figures from lower p15–16, so nothing on this leaf could be cross-checked against the dataset; every reading here is off the scan.

GLYPH CAUTIONS RESOLVED. 人 (strokes meeting at the apex) not 八/入 in 一人/二人/六人/三人. 十 in 四百十二 is a plain cross, so 412 not 1,002. 權 (木 + 艹 + 目-stack) confirmed at 7x in both 權大參事 and 來次權. 殿 in 高橋殿衞 is ink-clogged; the 尸-over-共 left side and 殳 right side are visible at 7x, but the reading of that given name is tentative.

OVERLAY. One pass rendered to _final.png and read back at half scale: all 27 boxes sit flush on their ink, none clips a glyph, none sits on whitespace, and the programmatic intersection test is clean, so no second pass was needed.

proposal.page_summary_en: Fascicle-9 officials return for Koga Domain (Shimōsa province, Doi house), printed book page 412. The establishment band gives 知事 1 person, 大參事 2, 權大參事 6 and 少參事 3; the 權少參事 label prints with no figure beside it, and the 兵隊 heading at the left edge stands alone with no troop figures, Koga's military return continuing on the facing leaf. Eighteen names print below in two registers — none under 知事, two senior councillors, six acting senior councillors, three junior councillors and seven acting junior councillors — so the unprinted 權少參事 establishment is 7 men, and 1 + 2 + 6 + 3 + 7 = 19 posts against 18 names, the one gap being the unnamed governor. The two senior councillors are entered as surname plus office title (土井大參事, 小杉大參事) with no given name, and all six acting senior councillors are entered by surname alone with a printed vertical rule running down the empty name slots.

proposal.page_header_kanji: 藩制一覽表第九（安志、淺尾）
proposal.page_header_en: Hansei ichiran, Fascicle Nine (Anji, Asao)
proposal.page_topic: Domain officials and troops

neighbour_domains.evidence: The ○安志藩 maru-marker stands in the rightmost column (ink x2558-2646). Its five columns — 知事 一人 (x2430-2505), 大參事 一人 (x2297-2368), 權大參事 二人 (x2160-2231), 少參事 二人 (x2024-2094) and 兵隊 一小隊 役員トモ六十人 (label x1891-1958, value x1759-1826) — all print to the RIGHT of the ○淺尾藩 marker at x1611-1698, so by the right-to-left rule they are read before it and belong to Anji. No Anji material crosses the Asao marker.

proposal.reasoning:
PAGE TYPE. Fascicle 9 (officials + military). The running header in the left margin (ink x832-889, y1232-1919) reads 藩制一覽表第九（安志、淺尾）, so the fascicle number is 9 and the header names both domains printed here. The printed book-page number in the bottom margin (ink x816-868, y3079-3326) reads 四百二十七 = 427; the 十 is a plain cross, not 千. MASTER holds no rows for this page, so every value below was read off the scan itself.

MARKERS AND OWNERSHIP. Two maru-markers, both measured by ink projection: ○安志藩 at x2558-2646 (circle y1321-1397, 安 y1428-1508, 志 y1605-1684, 藩 y1781-1863) and ○淺尾藩 at x1611-1698 (circle y1316-1393, 淺 y1426-1502, 尾 y1602-1683, 藩 y1777-1860). Right-to-left rule: everything to the RIGHT of a marker was read earlier and belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything to its LEFT belongs to the marked domain. The ○安志藩 marker is the rightmost thing on the page, so Anji's block runs from that marker leftward and stops at the ○淺尾藩 marker; Asao's block runs from x1611 leftward to the header column. Nothing overflows past a marker here — Anji's military (兵隊, x1891-1958) prints at x1749-1968, still to the right of the Asao marker, so the fascicle-8/9 overflow trap does not bite on this page.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT. Band-restricted column projections gave the office columns cleanly. Anji block (label band y1200-1600, count band y1640-1820, each count sitting squarely in its own label's column): 知事 x2436-2505 / count x2430-2496 = 一人; 大參事 x2300-2368 / x2297-2361 = 一人; 權大參事 x2162-2231 / x2160-2226 = 二人; 少參事 x2028-2095 / x2024-2090 = 二人. Then the military: label 兵隊 at x1891-1958 (y1400-1547) with its value in the next column left, x1759-1826, reading 一 (y1253-1263) 小 (1314-1368) 隊 (1395-1458) then in smaller type 役 員 ト モ 六 十 人 (y1481-1940) = 一小隊 役員トモ六十人, i.e. one platoon, sixty men including officers. 六 has its top lid, 十 is a plain cross, 人 has its apex closed — checked at 3.2x.

Asao block. Office labels project at x957-1026, x1095-1162, x1222-1290, x1356-1424, x1490-1558 (pitch about 133 px). Counts project at x1040-1090, x1095-1154, x1221-1286, x1355-1420, x1488-1549. Four of the five counts sit in their own label column; the fifth, at x1040-1090 / y1421-1570, sits one half-column RIGHT of the 權少參事 label (x957-1026) and slightly lower, in marginally smaller type. It cannot belong to 少參事, whose own count 一人 already occupies x1095-1154 at y1421-1538; and no column exists left of 權少參事 except the header, so this offset 二人 is the 權少參事 count, indented by the typesetter to clear the four-glyph label. I therefore boxed 權少參事 as one box spanning label and offset count (x947-1092), with the 少參事 box starting at x1093 so the two never overlap. Reading: 知事 一人, 大參事 一人, 權大參事 二人, 少參事 一人, 權少參事 二人 — seven posts in all.

NAME REGISTERS. Two name registers print below the counts. Register 1 (y1950-2600) has four columns at x944-1017, x1084-1150, x1213-1275, x1343-1415. Their centres sit about 11 px left of the office-label centres (980/1117/1244/1379 against 991/1128/1256/1390), i.e. the same columns, not a one-column shift — so each name belongs to the office directly above it: 大參事 = 垪和瀨平, 權大參事 = 角田圓治, 少參事 = 高田筑母, 權少參事 = 箕輪喜多務. The 知事 column (x1488-1558) has no ink at all below y1535, so no governor's name is printed. Register 2 (y2740-3520) holds three names at x1202-1269, x1072-1140, x935-1007, with a small-type 公議人 label at x1272-1325, y2761-2942 — to the upper right of the first name, so it heads the group: 垪和締藏, 上田麿三, 武藤新吾.

GLYPH CHECKS. 垪 (x1343-1415 y1982-2042, and again x1202-1269 y2905-2968): 土 radical plus 幷; the Bitchu/Mimasaka surname 垪和 (Haga), read at 9x. 瀨: 氵 + 束 + right component with the wide top bar, stack and splayed feet. 平 not 半 — the long horizontal is at the very top with the two side strokes beneath it (9x zoom). 圓 — 囗 enclosing 員 (9x zoom); template matching against 圍/圖/國 confirmed the inner 員 stack. 治 top-ranked in template matching (0.613). 筑 = 竹 over 工+凡 (9x zoom). 母 vs 毋 is genuinely close (template scores 0.741 vs 0.724); I read 母. 締 = 糸 + 帝 (9x zoom, template 0.417 a clear first). One glyph is not fully settled: 上田's third character (x1071-1140, y3242-3308) is heavily inked. Its top two-thirds is unmistakably 麻 (广 over 林); the bottom third distinguishes 麿/麾/摩/磨. Ink-fraction-matched template matching against MS Mincho, calibrated first on three known glyphs (藤, 新, 締 each ranked first), returned 麾 0.790, 麿 0.709, 摩 0.703 — no decisive margin, and 麾三/摩三 are not Japanese given names. I transcribe 麿 as the only plausible name character and flag it as the page's one uncertain glyph.

ARITHMETIC. No printed totals to reconcile on this page: the office counts are independent (Asao 1+1+2+1+2 = 7 posts, Anji 1+1+2+2 = 6 posts), and the only compound military figure, 一小隊 / 六十人, states platoon and headcount separately rather than as a sum. Four of Asao's seven posts are named, plus three 公議人.

COMPLETENESS. After masking all 22 boxes I re-scanned the whole text area (x760-2700, y300-4150) for ink below 120. Three residual clusters remain: 5 px at y2113-2114/x818-820, 6 px at y2934-2935/x2252-2254, and a 14x14 px ink blot at y3257-3270/x907-920 beside the page number. All three are specks far smaller than any glyph and are not boxed. Binding-edge black (x below 400) and the scan frame were excluded. No box overlaps any other (checked pairwise); interior padding is about 10 px on every side except three deliberate tight adjacencies (少參事 left edge 1 px, 權少參事 right edge 2 px, 公議人氏名一 right edge 2 px) where neighbouring ink is only 3-5 px away.
proposal.page_summary_en: Fascicle nine of the 1870 Hansei ichiran, page 427, records the office establishments of two 10,000-koku domains. Anji (Harima) reports one governor, one senior councillor, two acting senior councillors and two junior councillors, together with a single platoon of troops numbering sixty men including officers. Asao (Bitchu) reports one governor, one senior councillor, two acting senior councillors, one junior councillor and two acting junior councillors — seven posts — of which four incumbents are named: Haga Sehei, Kakuta Enji, Takada Chikubo and Minowa Kitamu. No name is printed for the Asao governor. A second register lists three men under the heading kogijin, the domain's representatives to the deliberative assembly: Haga Teizo, Ueda Marozo and Muto Shingo. No troop figure is printed for Asao on this page.

verdicts.corrected_modern_jp_reading: 上田麿三（うえだ まろぞう）
verdicts.corrected_english_translation: Second name listed under the kogijin heading: Ueda Marozo. The third character is heavily inked; its upper two-thirds is 麻, and the bottom component reads as 呂, giving 麿.
verdicts.issue: THE ONE GLYPH ON THIS PAGE THAT TEMPLATE MATCHING COULD NOT SETTLE, resolved instead by reading the enclosed white spaces off the pixels. Ink x1072-1139; rows 2908-2964, 3080-3135, 3243-3307, and 三 as three separate horizontals at 3419-3426, 3439-3445, 3462-3470. Pads 11/10/10/10. 上 templated 0.675 and 田 0.503, both first, on a run calibrated so that 藤 in the neighbouring column also ranked first (0.690). Glyph 3 is a plugged type piece: three separate template runs disagreed with each other (raw crop 麾 0.674 / 麿 0.590; unsharp-masked crop 慶 0.397 / 麿 0.268; bottom-third only 廣 0.225 / 麿 0.051), so none of them is evidence. I printed the glyph as an ASCII ink map at three thresholds instead. It shows a 丶 at y3242-3246, a full-width horizontal at y3250-3252 and a left descender running to y3301 (= 广); two side-by-side elements separated by a light gap at x1106-1110 through y3263-3267 (= 林, so the top is 麻); and at the bottom right, x1098-1133, two stacked enclosed light regions at y3285-3287 and y3292-3299 with a solid band between them. Two enclosed spaces stacked is 呂, not the 毛 of 麾, the 手 of 摩, the single 口 of 石 in 磨, or the 幺 of 麼 — so 麿. Left standing but flagged: the kana reading まろぞう is a conjecture, and the glyph is the one place on this leaf where a second reader should look.
