proposal.page_header_en: Table of Domain Institutions, Fascicle Nine (Sakura)
proposal.page_topic: Saga domain's military establishment, then the opening of Sakura domain's officials entry
proposal.page_summary_en: This leaf (printed page 430) of fascicle nine, the officials-and-military register, holds the end of Saga domain's entry and the first two columns of Sakura domain's. Saga's entry closes with a fourth gon-daisanji, Maeyama Seiichiro, and the note that junior councillors and below were not ascertained, then gives its armed force: six battalions and thirty-six cannon, broken down into 864 officers, 180 samurai-rank gunners, 1,440 samurai-rank infantry, 108 artillery privates, 260 infantry privates and 120 powder handlers, which sum to 2,972 men although the page prints no total. The maru-marker ○佐倉藩 then opens Sakura domain, of which only the office heading 知事 (governor) falls on this leaf; the governor's name continues on the facing page.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The maru-marker ○佐倉藩 stands at x=576-662, y=1387-1932. Everything left of it -- the single column 知事 at x=450-516 -- belongs to Sakura; the governor's name is not on this leaf. The running header on the same page reads 藩制一覽表第九（佐倉）, matching the convention on lower_p226_left, whose header read （佐賀） on the leaf where Saga's marker appears.

Everything right of the ○佐倉藩 marker (x from 706 to 2133) continues the entry that began at the ○佐賀藩 marker on lower_p226_left, printed page 四百二十九. On that leaf Saga's block runs 知事 欠員 / 大參事 中野內匠 / 權大參事 池田彌一, 深江助右衞門, 張玄一; the bare name 前山淸一郎 here sits at y=1703, the same name-band as 深江助右衞門 (y=1705) and the other Saga names on p226_left, so it is a fourth gon-daisanji continuing that list. The military sums to 2,972 men with 36 cannon, matching the figure the project already holds for Saga's fascicle-9 military entry.

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN 3095x4489. One ink-projection over y=900-2400 (threshold px<120) returned fourteen glyph columns, right to left: 2201-2253, 2067-2134, 1930-1999, 1800-1865, 1666-1729, 1528-1593, 1397-1463, 1261-1329, 1126-1192, 988-1055, 852-919, 716-784, 576-663, 451-517. A second projection over y=3090-3370 found the printed page number at x=2201-2251.

MARKER AND OWNERSHIP. The page holds exactly ONE maru-marker: ○佐倉藩 at x=576-662, y=1387-1932 (zoomed and read glyph by glyph: circle, 佐, 倉, 藩). By the right-to-left rule everything RIGHT of it belongs to the PREVIOUS domain and everything LEFT to Sakura. So the twelve columns from x=706 rightward to x=2133 are the previous domain's, and only 知事 (x=450-516) is Sakura's.

WHO IS THE PREVIOUS DOMAIN. The running header names 佐倉, but that is provenance for the leaf on which a domain's marker appears, not the owner of the data to the marker's right. I read the preceding leaf, lower_p226_left (printed page 四百二十九): its right-hand block is Ashikaga (知事 一人 戸田忠行 / 大參事 一人 川上廣樹 / 權大參事 一人 善野秀 / 少參事 佐藤保之, 安田義苗 / 兵隊審ナラス), then the marker ○佐賀藩 opens Saga with 知事 欠員 / 大參事 中野內匠 / 權大參事 池田彌一, 深江助右衞門, 張玄一, and that page's header reads （佐賀）. Saga's entry therefore runs onto this leaf. Two measurements confirm it. (1) Band alignment: on p226_left the bare continuation names begin at y=1701-1705; the bare name 前山淸一郎 here begins at y=1703, the same band, with no office title above it in its column (that column has zero ink above y=1703). (2) Arithmetic and scale: the six personnel counts sum to 864+180+1440+108+260+120 = 2,972 men beside 36 cannon, a force far beyond 11,000-koku Ashikaga, and the figure the project already records for Saga's fascicle-9 military entry. Ashikaga's own military is closed out on p226_left by 兵隊審ナラス. Owner set to 佐賀藩 on all twelve right-hand boxes.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
1. x2200-2253, y1286-1844, small type: 藩制一覽表第九（佐倉）. Running header, provenance, not data.
2. x2067-2133, y1703-2268: 前山淸一郎, five glyphs (前 / 山 / 淸 / 一 / 郎; the thin 一 at y≈2103-2117 fell below the run filter but is plain at 2x). Bare name continuing Saga's 權大參事 list.
3. x1929-1998, y1203-1920: 少參事以下審ナラス. The fourth glyph has a clear 宀 roof over 番 -- 審 (tsumabiraka), not 詳; both spell tsumabiraka narazu, "not ascertained". Editorial absence note.
4. x1799-1865, y1205-1434: 六大隊. Six battalions.
5. x1665-1728, y1209-1352: 內譯, the breakdown label. Structural, not data; boxed because it is a printed two-glyph label, unlike a bare 内.
6. x1527-1592, y1210-1606: 砲三十六門. 36 cannon.
7. x1397-1463, y1299-1947: 士官八百六十四員 = 864.
8. x1261-1328, y1297-1777: 砲士百八拾人 = 180 (拾 is the formal ten).
9. x1125-1192, y1300-1948: 兵士千四百四十人 = 1,440. The third glyph carries the slanted stroke on top -- 千, not 十, checked at 2.6x.
10. x987-1055, y1299-1695: 砲卒百八人 = 108. The last glyph's strokes touch at the apex -- 人, not 八.
11. x852-919, y1299-1864: 兵卒貳百六十人 = 260 (貳 = 2).

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN 3094x4489 px. Fascicle 9 (officials + military). One maru-marker on the leaf: ○水口藩 at x1900-1984, y1328-1866 (ink-measured). Right-to-left rule applied: everything RIGHT of x1900 belongs to the PREVIOUS domain, everything LEFT belongs to 水口藩.

COLUMN ENUMERATION (ink projection, threshold px<120, over y600-4200, x500-3000; column ink runs, right to left): 2587-2657 | 2455-2523 | 2319-2390 | 2179-2254 | 2041-2110 | 1900-1984 (marker) | 1771-1846 | 1636-1714 | 1506-1579 (+ a separate 1580-1609 run) | 1372-1446 | 1244-1314 | 1114-1181 | 979-1049 | 853-917 (margin 柱). Global ink extent x853-2656, y982-3482, so nothing was missed outside the boxed set. One 7x6 px speck at x2621-2628, y3171-3177 is dust and is NOT boxed. The faint grey vertical runs visible around x1000-1600, y1800-2600 are facing-page bleed-through (they never cross the <120 ink threshold) and are NOT boxed.

WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
(1) x2587-2657: 權大參事 (label y984-1298) 五人 (y1405-1548). (2) x2455-2523: 少參事 四人. (3) x2319-2390: 權少參事 四人. (4) x2179-2254: 兵隊 (y983-1128) 四百四十九人 (y1237-1714) 士族 (y1823-1972). (5) x2041-2110: 二百三十九人 (y1245-1715) 卒 (y1821-1885). These five columns are right of the ○水口藩 marker, so all five belong to the PREVIOUS domain.

WHO IS THE PREVIOUS DOMAIN. I opened the facing leaf, images/lower_p234_right.jpg (book page 四百四十四). Its last column carries ○宮津藩 followed by 大參事　一人, i.e. Miyazu's block opens at the far left of 234R and runs onto this leaf. The project's MASTER independently records the same adjacency in fascicle 7 (宮津藩 at lower p71-72, 水口藩 at p72-73). So the right-hand five columns are 宮津藩 (Miyazu), whose officials tally reads 大參事 1 (on 234R) + 權大參事 5 + 少參事 4 + 權少參事 4 = 14, with no names printed for Miyazu.

ARITHMETIC NET. 兵隊 splits into two side-by-side runs in the M/F pattern: right run 四百四十九人 士族 = 449, left run 二百三十九人 卒 = 239; 449 + 239 = 688 troops for Miyazu. No total is printed on the page, so this is my sum, not the source's. Cross-check: MASTER's fascicle-7 row for 宮津藩 (lower p72 L) reads 兵隊 二百三十九人 = 239 persons — the fascicle-7 clerk entered only the 卒 component, and this fascicle-9 leaf shows why (the shizoku half is a separate run). Both figures are internally consistent with Miyazu's fascicle-7 status population, 士族 2,298 persons and 卒族 1,048 persons: 449/2,298 = 19.5 percent and 239/1,048 = 22.8 percent, plausible adult-male mobilization shares. Digit check on 十 vs 千 at 6x: both 十 glyphs are plain crosses with no ノ on top, so 449 and 239, not 4,409/2,309.

(6) x1900-1984: the ○水口藩 marker; the running header in the left margin also prints （水口）, so the leaf's provenance and its principal domain agree.
(7) x1771-1846: 大參事　一人　中村栗翁 (name glyphs at y1992, 2159, 2329, 2498; 栗 and 翁 verified at 6x).
(8) x1636-1714: 權大參事　二人 with TWO four-slot name blocks, 加藤精一 (y1992-2535) and 岡田正和 (y2921-3483). Count 2 = 2 names printed.
(9) x1506-1579: 少參事　二人, with ONE four-slot name block using slots 1 and 4 only — 佃 (y1992-2053) and 極 (y2498-2556), both verified at 8x (亻+田; 木+亟). So the printed count is 2 but only one name appears.
(10) x1580-1608, y1402-1460: two small marks printed immediately right of the numeral 二 in that column — a large wedge over a small dot, crisp type-quality ink (447 ink px), the only such mark on the leaf. I read it as an editorial side-mark (傍点) flagging the numeral; I cannot establish its exact editorial meaning from this leaf, and I do not claim one. Boxed separately as a non-data mark.
(11) x1372-1446: 權少參事 with NO headcount printed between the label and the names (the y1400-1550 slot every other office column uses is blank here), then TWO name blocks, 井碕與山 (y1997-2562, all four glyphs verified at 4x) and 今村　昇 (y2919-3483, slots 1, 2 and 4). So this column is the mirror image of column (9): two names and no count, where (9) has a count of two and one name. I record both exactly as printed and flag the mismatch rather than reconciling it.
(12) x1244-1314: 鬪虎隊　一小隊五十人. First glyph verified at 9x — the 鬥 radical with hooked uprights and splayed feet, so 鬪, not 開/關.
(13) x1114-1181: 敢死隊　一小隊五十人.
(14) x979-1049: 礮隊　一分隊二十四人. First glyph verified at 9x — 石 radical left, 敫 right with 攵 at lower right, so 礮 (= 砲), artillery.
(15) x853-917, y1248-1808: the margin 柱, 藩制一覧表第九（水口）. (16) same column, y3092-3334: the printed book-page number 四百四十五 = 445 (five small-type glyphs, consistent with 233R = 四百四十二 and 235L = 四百四十七 in the project's page index).

SECOND ARITHMETIC NET, on 水口's corps. 鬪虎隊 50 + 敢死隊 50 = 100 men in two companies, plus 礮隊 24 in one section. MASTER's fascicle-7 rows for 水口藩 (lower p73 L) read 兵隊 二小隊 一小隊五十人 外隊長二十八人 = 100 persons and 砲隊 二十四人 = 24 persons. The two independent fascicles reconcile exactly: fascicle 7's anonymous "two companies of fifty" are named here as the Tōko-tai and the Kanshi-tai, and its 砲隊 24 is this leaf's 礮隊 24. That match also confirms the 五十 readings are 50 and not 5 or 500.

GEOMETRY. Every box is the ink bbox of its column padded ~10 px. Minimum horizontal gap between adjacent boxes is 12 px (the side-dot box against the 水口權大參事 box); all other gaps are 34-49 px. A programmatic pairwise test found zero overlaps. One overlay pass was rendered to _final.png and read; no box clipped a glyph, overlapped a neighbour, or sat on whitespace, so no second pass was needed.
proposal.page_header_en: Domain Survey (藩制一覧表), Fascicle 9 — Minakuchi (水口藩): officials and corps
proposal.page_topic: Miyazu's officials tally and troop strength, then the ○水口藩 marker opening Minakuchi's councillor roster and its three named corps
proposal.page_summary_en: The ○水口藩 marker sits at the middle of this leaf and divides it. To its right stands the tail of Miyazu domain (宮津藩), whose block opened on the facing leaf (book page 444): councillor posts recorded as headcounts only, with no names — 權大參事 5, 少參事 4, 權少參事 4 — followed by Miyazu's troops, 449 men of shizoku status and 239 of sotsu status, 688 in all. To the marker's left is Minakuchi, a 25,000-koku Katō domain in Ōmi. Its councillors are 大參事 one man, Nakamura Ritsuō; 權大參事 two men, Katō Seiichi and Okada Masakazu; 少參事, printed as two men but with only one name given, Tsukuda Kiwamu; and 權少參事, printed with no headcount but two names, Isaki Yozan and Imamura Noboru. Minakuchi's forces close the leaf: the Tōko-tai (鬪虎隊) and the Kanshi-tai (敢死隊), one company of fifty men each, and an artillery corps (礮隊) of one section of twenty-four — figures that reconcile exactly with the domain's fascicle-7 entry of two companies of fifty and a gun corps of twenty-four.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The facing leaf images/lower_p234_right.jpg (book page 四百四十四) ends with the ○宮津藩 marker followed by 大參事　一人, so Miyazu's block opens there and runs onto this leaf; the five columns right of the ○水口藩 marker here (權大參事 五人, 少參事 四人, 權少參事 四人, 兵隊 四百四十九人 士族, 二百三十九人 卒) are its continuation. The project's MASTER records the same 宮津藩 → 水口藩 adjacency in fascicle 7 (lower p71-72 and p72-73), and MASTER's fascicle-7 宮津藩 row 兵隊 二百三十九人 matches the 卒 run boxed here.

proposal.page_header_en: Overview of Domain Institutions, Fascicle 9 (Miyazu)
proposal.page_topic: Domain councillors and troop strength (fascicle 9)
proposal.page_summary_en: Printed page 444 of fascicle 9 records the domain administration and troops of Miharu (三春藩) and opens the entry for Miyazu (宮津藩). For Miharu the lower register names one daisanji, Akita Chigara, and six gon-daisanji — Hosokawa Karyū, Akita Yajūrō, Okumura Shin'ichirō, Akita Hiroki, Yamano Gonroku and Minato Junzō — while the upper register names three shōsanji (Ōmi Yūki, Akita Kazue, Takita Minato) and three gon-shōsanji (Fuwa Ikuma, Azuma Kanai, Kumada Kazen); the count of full and acting daisanji is entered separately as 不詳, not known. Miharu's forces are five rifle companies at a nominal 60 men each, that is 300 men less the 20 recorded as short, or 280, with 8 unit officers, plus an artillery corps of one and a half sections reckoned at 16 men to a section, or 24 men, with 2 officers. Below the ○宮津藩 marker Miyazu's entry begins with a single daisanji, one person, and continues on printed page 445 with 5 gon-daisanji, 4 shōsanji, 4 gon-shōsanji and troops of 449 shizoku and 239 sotsu.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The ○宮津藩 maru-marker stands at xywh=pixel:584,1313,107,563 (glyph runs: ○ y1323-1398, 宮 y1430-1509, 津 y1605-1687, 藩 y1784-1866). The single column to its left, x=469-537, reads 大參事　一人 and is therefore Miyazu's. Miyazu's entry continues on the facing sheet lower_p234_left (printed page 四百四十五), whose first four columns read 權大參事 五人 / 少參事 四人 / 權少參事 四人 / 兵隊 四百四十九人 士族・二百三十九人 卒 before that sheet's own ○水口藩 marker.

proposal.reasoning:
MARKER AND OWNERSHIP. The sheet holds exactly one maru-marker: ○宮津藩, measured at x=594-681, y=1323-1866. By the right-to-left rule everything to its right belongs to the previous domain and everything to its left to Miyazu. Only one column stands to its left (x=469-537: 大參事 / 一人), so Miyazu's entry opens here with a single line and continues on the facing sheet. All thirteen remaining data columns (x=743 through x=2157) lie to the right of the marker and belong to the previous domain.

WHICH PREVIOUS DOMAIN. MASTER's fascicle-7 sequence for this volume runs 湯長谷 (p.68) -> 水戸 (p.69-70) -> 三春 (p.70-71) -> 宮津 (p.71-72) -> 水口 (p.72-73). The fascicle-9 sheets reproduce that order: lower_p233_right is printed page 四百四十二 with the header 藩制一覽表第九（喜連川、結城、湯長谷）, and lower_p234_left is printed page 四百四十五 with the header （水口）. So the domain immediately before 宮津 is 三春藩 (Miharu, Mutsu; the Akita house). The surnames confirm it independently: 秋田 appears four times (秋田主計, 秋田千柄, 秋田彌十郎, 秋田廣記) and 湊 once (湊潤藏); 秋田 is the ruling house of Miharu and 湊 its ancestral name. The printed name 三春 appears nowhere on this sheet — its marker sits on the printed page 四百四十三, which is not in the viewer image set.

HEADER IS PROVENANCE, NOT OWNERSHIP. The running header names （宮津）, the domain whose entry OPENS on this sheet, not the domain that fills it. lower_p233_right shows the same convention, its header listing all three domains that open there. Eleven of the thirteen upper-register columns and all seven lower-register columns are Miharu's, so primary_domain_jp is 三春藩 rather than the domain the header names.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT. Right margin strip (x=2223-2276): running header at y=1227-1785, printed page number 四百四十四 at y=3067-3314. The text block runs from x=2157 leftward to x=469 at a column pitch of about 134 px, thirteen columns, set in two horizontal registers — an upper register at y about 970-2200 and a lower register at y about 2480-3490.
Upper register: (1) x=2092-2157 正權大參事／不詳; (2) x=1956-2026 少參事／大見勇記; (3) x=1819-1885 秋田主計, with a variant note at x=1890-1937; (4) x=1686-1751 瀧田湊; (5) x=1548-1616 權少參事／不破幾馬; (6) x=1416-1483 東嘉内; (7) x=1281-1349 熊田嘉膳, with a variant note at x=1297-1349; (8) x=1143-1209 銃兵／五小隊, with a double-column warichu at x=1125-1228; (9) x=1008-1075 役司八人; (10) x=874-943 大砲隊／一分半隊, with a warichu at x=890-943; (11) x=743-810 役司二人; (12) the marker; (13) x=469-537 大參事／一人.
Lower register, at the same seven column positions as upper columns 1 to 7: 大參事／秋田千柄; 權大參事／細川可柳; 秋田彌十郎; 奧村新一郎; 秋田廣記; 山野權六; 湊潤藏. The lower register is blank at every column left of x=1279, that is under the military columns, under the marker and under Miyazu's column, so no lower-register content belongs to Miyazu.

LABEL SCOPE. An office label governs its own column and the columns to its left until a new label appears. 少參事 therefore covers 大見勇記, 秋田主計 and 瀧田湊 (three); 權少參事 covers 不破幾馬, 東嘉内 and 熊田嘉膳 (three); 大參事 covers 秋田千柄 alone; 權大參事 covers 細川可柳, 秋田彌十郎, 奧村新一郎, 秋田廣記, 山野權六 and 湊潤藏 (six).

ONE INTERPRETIVE UNCERTAINTY, STATED. The upper register's rightmost column reads 正權大參事　不詳 while the lower register names a 大參事 and six 權大參事 for the same domain. I tested whether the two registers could belong to different domains and rejected it: both registers begin at the same rightmost column position (x=2087), and a domain block on these sheets is column-aligned, never split mid-column — on lower_p233_right the lower register is blank under 喜連川's single column and fills only under 結城's columns. I read 不詳 as the answer to the count question, that the number of full and acting daisanji was not reported, with the names supplied separately. I have not opened printed page 四百四十三, which would settle it.

GLYPH CHECKS AT SINGLE-CHARACTER MAGNIFICATION. I cropped the two variant notes at 5x and 9x. The note beside 秋田主計 reads 一員衞ニ作ル; the second and third glyphs are separate characters, 員 (口 over 貝) then 衞, giving the variant given name 員衞, which reads Kazue as 主計 does. The note beside 熊田嘉膳 reads 一善ニ作ル; the second glyph's top is horizontal-dense with a central vertical, so 善 rather than 普, and 善 is the phonetically consistent variant of 膳. In the 銃兵 warichu I checked 六十人 (六 has its top lid, so not 八) and 二十人 (十 is a plain cross with no ノ on top, so not 千).

ARITHMETIC. 銃兵: five companies at the nominal 一隊六十人 is 300 men, less the 但二十人不足 of 20, leaving 280. 大砲隊: one and a half sections at 一分隊十六人ノ積, 16 men reckoned to a section, is 24 men. Unit officers are counted separately, 8 for the riflemen and 2 for the artillery. No total is printed on the sheet, so nothing here cross-foots against a printed sum.

NOT BOXED. A speck at about x=2436-2446, y=876; the faint facing-page bleed-through in the middle of the sheet (much lighter ink, around x=600-700 and x=1200-1500); the dark scan border and the binding edge.

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing was cross-checked against it; every transcription here is read off this scan. I rendered one overlay of all 26 boxes, read it, and found no clipped glyph, no box on whitespace and no box on bleed-through; a programmatic pairwise rectangle-intersection test over all 26 boxes reported zero overlaps, so no second overlay pass was needed.

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN: 3095 x 4489 px. One maru-marker only, found by column ink-projection over x=400-2500, y=800-3700, which returned 14 vertical glyph runs. Reading RIGHT to LEFT:

COL0 x2245-2308 — two separate runs. Upper (y1234-1790) = the running head, read at 2.2x: 藩制一覽表第九（壬生）. Lower (y3075-3319) = the printed book-page number, read at 2.5x: 四百四十六 = 446 (十 is a plain cross, 六 shows its top lid). Both are page furniture, not data.

COL1 x2127-2193 y1229-1795: 鼓笛手　二十人.
COL2 x1995-2065 y1228-2131: 隊長以下役員　二十八人.
COL3 x1862-1932 y1231-1709: 器械方　十人.

COL4 x1717-1803 y1317-1856: the ONLY maru-marker on the leaf, read at 2.2x = ○壬生藩. Nothing circular appears in any other column.

OWNERSHIP. By the right-to-left rule everything RIGHT of ○壬生藩 was read earlier and belongs to the PREVIOUS domain, and in fascicle 9 a domain's military prints after its officials and overflows past the next domain's marker. COL1-COL3 are exactly that overflow: three military headcounts with no officials heading attached. I opened the facing earlier leaf, images/lower_p234_left.jpg, to name the previous domain: its running head reads 藩制一覽表第九（水口）, its book page is 四百四十五 (445, one before this leaf's 446), it opens with ○水口藩, and its last three columns are 闘虎隊一小隊五十人 / 敢死隊一小隊五十人 / 破隊一分隊二十四人 — a military list still in progress at the leaf edge. So 鼓笛手 20, 隊長以下役員 28 and 器械方 10 are 水口藩's, and every column LEFT of the marker is 壬生藩's.

COL5 x1593-1659: heading 大參事　一人 (y983-1542), name 大島金七郎 (y1991-2555; zoomed 2.5x — 七 has the horizontal-plus-hooked-vertical, not 九).
COL6 x1447-1531: heading 權大參事　五人 (y980-1542), then TWO names stacked in the same column, 渡邊一平 (y1984-2547) and 高須嘉司馬 (y2908-3475).
COL7 x1311-1435: 山家三太夫 (y1983-2551) in the upper name band; in the lower band a small-type side label 公議人 (x1379-1430, y2767-2965) with 増田鏘太郎 (x1311-1377, y2907-3476) below and to its left.
COL8 x1185-1254 y1982-2546: 福島渡理, an unheaded name column.

NAME-ORDER CONVENTION. The already-annotated facing leaf lower_p235_left fixes the layout: names fill the upper band then the lower band of the SAME column before moving one column left (三日月權大參事 = 竹田權左衞門 at x2191 band 1, 船曳孝 at x2186 band 2, 可兒勇之進 at x2057 band 1). Applying that here, the 權大參事 names run 渡邊一平, 高須嘉司馬, 山家三太夫, 福島渡理 — four names against five printed posts. That mismatch is normal in this fascicle: on lower_p235_left 峯山's 權大參事 prints 二人 and lists four names. The small 公議人 label sits to the right of 増田鏘太郎's column, which is where lower_p235_left also puts a side note (its 三人 傍記 at x2277 annotates the 權大參事 column at x2197), so 公議人 marks 増田鏘太郎 alone.

COL9 x1063-1130 y981-1544: 少參事　五人.
COL10 x927-993 y981-1542: 權少參事　五人.
COL11 x790-857 y983-1954: 兵隊　十二小隊但一隊三十人.
COL12 x654-725 y1064-2209: 合三百六十人　四隊但一隊九十人.
COL13 x520-593 y979-1625: 遊兵隊　二十八人.

ARITHMETIC NET. 12 platoons x 30 men = 360, which matches the printed 合三百六十人 exactly; the same 360 restated as 4 companies x 90 men = 360 also reconciles. Grand troop total on this leaf for 壬生 = 360 + 28 = 388. Official posts = 1 + 5 + 5 + 5 = 16. Glyphs checked at single-character zoom where confusable: 六 vs 八 in 四百四十六 and 三百六十人 (both show the top lid), 十 vs 千 throughout (all plain crosses, no slanted stroke on top), 人 vs 八 at every headcount terminal (strokes touch at the apex).

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing was cross-checked against it; every reading above is off the scan.

BOXES. Each box = tight ink bbox from a thresholded (px<120) row/column projection of a rough crop, padded ~10 px, then trimmed where two boxes would touch. The only near-collision was the 公議人+増田鏘太郎 box against 高須嘉司馬's column; I set their edges at x=1440 and x=1442. A programmatic pairwise rectangle-intersection test over all 19 boxes printed no overlaps, and the rendered overlay (_final.png, read back at 1/3 scale) shows every box enclosing its full glyph run with no clipping and none sitting on blank paper. One overlay pass; nothing needed correcting.

The facing earlier leaf images/lower_p234_left.jpg (book page 四百四十五 = 445) carries the running head 藩制一覽表第九（水口）, opens with the marker ○水口藩, and ends mid-military-list with 闘虎隊一小隊五十人 / 敢死隊一小隊五十人 / 破隊一分隊二十四人.

proposal.page_topic: Fascicle-9 officials roster and troop return
proposal.page_summary_en: The right-hand third of this leaf finishes Minakuchi domain's (水口藩) fascicle-9 military return, carried over from the facing leaf: a drum-and-fife corps of 20 men, 28 unit officers from company commander downward, and an ordnance section of 10 men. The marker ○壬生藩 then opens Mibu domain (壬生藩, Shimotsuke province), whose councillor establishment is 1 Grand Councillor, 5 Provisional Grand Councillors, 5 Junior Councillors and 5 Provisional Junior Councillors — 16 posts in all. Five men are named: Ōshima Kinshichirō as Grand Councillor, then Watanabe Ippei, Takasu Kashiba, Yamaga Sandayū and Fukushima Watari against the five Provisional Grand Councillor posts, with Masuda Shōtarō marked 公議人, the domain's delegate to the Kōgisho deliberative assembly. Mibu's forces are 12 platoons of 30 men, totalling the printed 360 and restated as 4 companies of 90, plus a 28-man skirmisher corps — 388 men on this leaf.

proposal.reasoning:
MEASUREMENT METHOD. Scan is 3094x4489 px. One ink projection (px<120) across x=600..3094, y=900..3600 gave 14 substantive glyph columns plus one 14-px speck at x=2840-2854 (167 ink px, facing-page bleed — not boxed). Row projections were then run inside each column. All boxes are those runs padded 10 px. A pairwise overlap test on the final 32 boxes returned zero overlaps; a 16-px halo test showed at most 16 stray ink px outside any box (anti-aliasing).

COLUMN GRID. The leaf is a three-row matrix: label band y=980-1310, row1 y=1360-2000, row2 y=2160-2810, row3 y=2860-3500. A column is read top-to-bottom and columns are read right-to-left.

MARU-MARKER. Exactly one marker on the page: ○嶋原藩 at x=1559-1647, y=1331-1874 (runs: ○ 1331-1408, 嶋 1438-1520, 原 1618-1697, 藩 1791-1874). Right-to-left rule: everything at x>1647 was read BEFORE the marker and therefore belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything at x<1559 belongs to 嶋原藩.

WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
x=2616-2722 — label 少參事 (y999-1226); names 宮北鄕左衞門 (r1), 梶彈右衞門 (r2), 里村縫殿 (r3). r3 is four glyphs, not five: zoomed at 1.75x it reads 里 村 縫 殿, so the name is 里村縫殿, not 一里村縫殿.
x=2508-2580 — 三浦彦太夫 in row1 only, rows 2-3 empty. This is the fourth 少參事, overflowing into a new column because a column holds only three cells.
x=2348-2457 — label 權少參事 (y995-1308); 佐藤八右衞門, 久米三左衞門, 七里作左衞門.
x=2219-2314 — 寺田惣次郎, 山崎重三郎, 寺田與一郎.
x=2084-2179 — 相馬作左衞門, 山田吉太郎, 三宅助三郎.
x=1946-2049 — 富樫萬吉, 速水織衞, 遠藤勇二郎. (權少參事 therefore totals twelve.)
x=1844-1921 — 步兵 (label) / 三大隊 / smaller-type note 一小隊六十人 (y1514-1890) / 八小隊ヲ以一大隊トス (y1984-2637). A column projection over x=1840-1930 returned a single run, so the note is inline single-column, not warichu.
x=1710-1788 — 砲兵 (label) / 二百人.
x=1559-1647 — ○嶋原藩 marker.
x=1437-1514 — 大少參事 (label, y989-1304) / 八人. Second glyph zoomed at 2.2x is 少 (has the left-falling stroke), not 小.
x=1266-1383 — 常備兵 (label) / 四小隊 / true double-column warichu at y1574-1965, right sub-column 一隊六十人, left sub-column 士官三十六人. Rows 2-3 of this column carry the officials register: 大參事 (label, y2332-2564) and 松平定衞 (y2920-3489).
x=1132-1239 — 豫備 (label) / 七小隊; row3 澁川勝廸.
x=1001-1107 — 炮隊 (label) / 三隊 / 一隊二十人 (y1503-1805); row2 權大參事 (label), row3 眞田幸成.
x=884-970 — running header 藩制一覽表第九（島原）(y1238-1796) and printed page number 四百五十三 (y3081-3326).

TWO-REGISTER LAYOUT. The 嶋原藩 block splits vertically: the label band and row1 hold a summary line (大少參事 八人) and the military (常備兵・豫備・炮隊), while rows 2-3 of the same columns hold the named officials. Reading each column top-to-bottom gives 大參事 松平定衞 and 澁川勝廸 (two men), then 權大參事 眞田幸成 (one).

OWNERSHIP. The previous domain is 新發田藩. Evidence: the facing right-hand leaf lower_p238_right (printed page 452) carries the header 藩制一覽表第九（新發田）and the ○新發田藩 marker, followed by 大參事 溝口伊織・窪田平兵衞 and 權大參事 溝口甚太郎・速水八彌・溝口半兵衞; the officials to the right of that marker (江原素六, 向山黄村, 中村勘作, 深山宇平太) are Shizuoka men, so Shibata's block opens there and its 少參事/權少參事 and military run onto this leaf. 速水 recurs here as 速水織衞. Every box at x>1647 is therefore owned by 新發田藩; every box at x<1559 by 嶋原藩. The header column is provenance for the 嶋原藩 entry that opens here.

PRIMARY DOMAIN. This is a judgement call and the two criteria pull apart. By ink, 新發田藩 has the larger share: eight columns (x=1710-2722, twenty boxes) against 嶋原藩's five columns including the marker (x=1001-1647, ten boxes). By the book's own labelling, the page is Shimabara's: the sole marker on the leaf is ○嶋原藩, the running header reads （島原）, and 嶋原藩 is the only domain name printed on the page, so it is the only value domain_hi_name can take from this leaf. I set primary_domain_jp = 嶋原藩 on that basis and record 新發田藩 as the right-of-marker neighbour.

ARITHMETIC. Shibata infantry: 三大隊 at 八小隊 per 大隊 and 六十人 per 小隊 = 3 x 8 x 60 = 1,440 men; internally consistent, and no printed total is given to check it against. Shibata artillery 二百人 = 200, printed directly. Shimabara 常備兵 四小隊 at 一隊六十人 = 240 men plus 士官三十六人 = 36 officers. 豫備 七小隊 with no rate printed — I do not multiply it by 60. 炮隊 三隊 at 一隊二十人 = 60. One figure does NOT reconcile: 大少參事 八人 declares eight councillors of senior and junior grade, but only three are named on this leaf (松平定衞, 澁川勝廸, 眞田幸成). The remaining five are not named on this page; the entry presumably continues on the next right-hand leaf, which I did not open, so I make no claim about where they appear.

GLYPH NOTES. Shibata writes its artillery 砲兵 (石 radical); Shimabara writes 炮隊 (火 radical) — the difference is in the scan, not a transcription slip. 澁川勝廸's fourth glyph is 廸 (辶 + 由), zoomed at 2.6x.

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing was cross-checked against it; every reading above comes from the scan.

proposal.page_topic: domain councillors and troop strength
proposal.page_summary_en: Printed page 453 of fascicle nine of the Hansei ichiran, the 1870 register of domain officials and military establishment. The right eight columns finish Shibata domain's entry, opened on the facing leaf: four 少參事 (Miyakita Gōzaemon, Kaji Dan'uemon, Satomura Nuidono, Miura Hikodayū) and twelve 權少參事, then Shibata's forces — three infantry battalions, reckoned at eight platoons to a battalion and sixty men to a platoon, and 200 artillerymen. The maru-marker ○嶋原藩 at x=1559 opens Shimabara domain's entry, which gives eight councillors of senior and junior grade as a bare headcount, four standing-troop platoons at sixty men each with thirty-six officers, seven reserve platoons, and three artillery units of twenty men each. Shimabara's named officers are two 大參事, Matsudaira Sadae and Shibukawa Katsumichi, and one 權大參事, Sanada Yukishige; the other five of the eight councillors are not named on this leaf.

neighbour_domains.evidence: Sixteen official names and the 步兵/砲兵 lines occupy x=1710-2722, all read before the ○嶋原藩 marker at x=1559-1647. The block opens on the facing right-hand leaf lower_p238_right (printed page 452), whose running header reads 藩制一覽表第九（新發田）and whose ○新發田藩 marker is followed by 大參事 溝口伊織・窪田平兵衞 and 權大參事 溝口甚太郎・速水八彌・溝口半兵衞; the surname 速水 recurs on this leaf as 速水織衞.

proposal.reasoning:
MEASUREMENT. Scan is 3095x4489. A black scan frame occupies rows 0-190 and 4230-4489, columns 2700-3095 and 0-110; none of that is boxed. An ink projection over y=950-3600 (threshold px<120, run threshold >4 inked px, min width 8) returned exactly 14 vertical glyph runs, right to left: 2230-2296, 2099-2175, 1965-2042, 1834-1908, 1701-1787, 1571-1650, 1435-1509, 1303-1380, 1165-1244, 1033-1113, 900-972, 763-848, 632-707, 488-575. A per-column row projection then split each into blocks; every column carries up to three name blocks at y~1460-2040, y~2215-2795 and y~2970-3555, with office headings at y~1040-1370.

MARU-MARKER AND OWNERSHIP. There is exactly ONE maru-marker on the leaf: the circle plus 新發田藩 in the column at x 763-848, y 1379-1968 (zoomed at 3x, marker.png: clean ○ then 新, 發, 田, 藩). By the right-to-left rule, everything RIGHT of x=848 was read earlier and belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything LEFT of x=763 belongs to 新發田藩. That splits the leaf 10 text columns (29 names) to the right versus 2 name columns plus 2 office headings (5 names) to the left. The five left-side names are 溝口伊織, 窪田平兵衞, 溝口甚太郎, 速水八彌, 溝口半兵衞 — 溝口 being the Shibata daimyo house, which independently confirms the marker's ownership rule.

WHO IS THE PREVIOUS DOMAIN. The names right of the marker are 江原素六, 向山黄村, 大久保樫軒, 矢田堀喜六, 杉浦八郎五郎, 深山宇平太, 淵邊德藏 — the Shizuoka-han (former Tokugawa) administration. I checked this against the project's own index rather than relying on the names alone: outputs/hansei_ichiran_reocr/HI_pdf_bookmark_index.csv, filtered to Vol2 (下) fascicle 9, lists 静岡藩 beginning at pdf_page 237 and 新宮藩 at pdf_page 239, with pdf_page 238 in between. So this leaf is the tail of 靜岡藩's officials roster and the head of 新發田藩's. The index has no bookmark row for 新發田藩 (it is a partial index), which is why MASTER supplied no rows for this page.

RUNNING HEADER VS DATA. The rightmost column (x 2230-2296, y 1304-1918) is the running header 藩制一覽表第九（新發田）, printed in smaller type (~51px per glyph against ~60px for the body). It names 新發田 — the domain that BEGINS on this leaf — not the domain that supplies most of the content. I have set primary_domain to 靜岡藩 because 29 of the 34 name entries and 10 of the 13 text columns are Shizuoka's, and recorded 新發田藩 as the neighbour left of the marker. The printed book-page number 四百五十二 (452) sits in the same column at y 3145-3386.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (all readings taken from 2.4-3x crops; montages mont_a/mont_b/mont_c and mont2_a/mont2_b/mont2_c):
1. x2230-2296 — running header; below it, page number 四百五十二.
2. x2099-2175 — 平岡四郎 / 小栗尚三 / 藤澤長太郎.
3. x1965-2042 — 江原素六 / 大久保樫軒 / 中臺信太郎.
4. x1834-1908 — 向山黄村 / 河田熙 / 朝倉藤十郎 (middle block is only 3 glyphs).
5. x1701-1787 — heading 權少參事 (4 glyphs, y1047-1362, verified at 3x) then 杉浦八郎五郎 / 小林庄次郎 / 矢田堀喜六.
6. x1571-1650 — 今堀登代太郎 / 石川周二 / 依田素一 (final 一 is the thin run y3508-3518).
7. x1435-1509 — 淵邊德藏 / 川上服二郎 / 高力晴江.
8. x1303-1380 — 中村勘作 / 多田銑三郎 / 福岡久.
9. x1165-1244 — 根立蘆水 / 深山宇平太 / 宮田文吾.
10. x1033-1113 — 宮重丹下 / 西吉十郎 / 牧野田三.
11. x900-972 — 小林甚六郎 / 石川渡; the bottom block of this column is EMPTY (row projection returned no run below y2793), which is where the Shizuoka roster stops.
12. x763-848 — ○新發田藩 marker.
13. x632-707 — heading 大參事 (y1047-1277) then 溝口伊織 / 窪田平兵衞; bottom block empty.
14. x488-575 — heading 權大參事 (y1050-1364) then 溝口甚太郎 / 速水八彌 / 溝口半兵衞.

The three columns right of the 權少參事 heading (平岡四郎, 江原素六, 向山黄村 and the names below them) carry no heading on this leaf; their rank block was headed on the preceding leaf, so I left their field_jp as 職員姓名 rather than invent an office for them.

GLYPH CHECKS. 八 vs 人: 杉浦八郎五郎 and 速水八彌 both show the two strokes separate at the apex and splaying — 八. 太 vs 大: 溝口甚太郎, 藤澤長太郎, 中臺信太郎, 深山宇平太, 今堀登代太郎 all show the lower-right dot — 太. 十 vs 千: 西吉十郎 and 朝倉藤十郎 show a plain cross with no slanted top stroke — 十. The one genuinely hard glyph is the fourth character of 大久保◻軒 (x1965-2042, y2599-2662). I zoomed it to 9x (kashi3.png) and to a right-component-only view (kashi2.png). A template-correlation test against 樫/橿/檀/桓 and 22 other 木-radical characters in msmincho, yumin and simsun returned nothing above r=0.34, so it decided nothing and I read the glyph structurally instead: the base of the right component is a short horizontal, a vertical through it, and a wider bottom horizontal — 土, not 旦 (which would give a box) and not a bare 一. 木 + [boxy upper element] + 土 is 堅, so the character is 樫: 大久保樫軒. I flag this as the one uncertain glyph on the leaf. 根立蘆水's third glyph shows a clear 艹 crown in mont_a, so 蘆 not 廬; the printed block is over-inked and unreadable at single-character zoom, so the crown in the 2.4x montage is the evidence.

NO ARITHMETIC NET APPLIES. This is a fascicle-9 officials leaf: there are no totals, no sub-counts, no koku or population figures anywhere on it, so there is nothing to sum-check. Every substantive element is a personal name, an office heading, the marker, the running header, or the page number.

NOT BOXED. Faint facing-page bleed-through is visible in the empty lower-right quadrant (much lighter ink, e.g. around x1150-1500 / y3600-3900) and in the blank upper half; none of it is printed matter on this leaf. The black scan frame and binding edge are likewise excluded.

GEOMETRY VERIFICATION. Each box was set to the measured column x-range and measured block y-range with 8px padding, then re-measured: every box's internal ink starts 7-8px from its top and ends 7-8px from its bottom, and no box's x-range comes within 27px of a neighbour's. Two boxes needed widening after that check — the 中村勘作/多田銑三郎/福岡久 column (ink reached 1387, one px outside the projected column edge; widened to 1288-1396) and the 宮重丹下/西吉十郎/牧野田三 column (ink reached 1028; widened to 1017-1121). One overlay pass at _final.png confirmed all 40 boxes enclose their runs with no clipping, no overlap and none on whitespace, so I did not run a second pass.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The only maru-marker on the leaf, ○新發田藩, occupies x763-848 / y1379-1968. Everything left of it is Shibata's: the 大參事 heading with 溝口伊織 and 窪田平兵衞, and the 權大參事 heading with 溝口甚太郎, 速水八彌 and 溝口半兵衞. 溝口 is the Shibata daimyo house. The running header at the far right also reads 藩制一覽表第九（新發田）, and HI_pdf_bookmark_index.csv places 静岡藩 at pdf_page 237 and 新宮藩 at pdf_page 239, leaving 新發田藩 to begin on this leaf.

All ten text columns right of the marker (x900 through x2175) were read before it and therefore belong to the previous domain. The names are the Shizuoka-han administration — 江原素六, 向山黄村, 大久保樫軒, 矢田堀喜六, 杉浦八郎五郎, 深山宇平太, 淵邊德藏 — and HI_pdf_bookmark_index.csv (Vol2, fascicle 9) begins 静岡藩 at pdf_page 237, one leaf before this one.

proposal.page_header_en: Survey of Domain Institutions, Fascicle 9 (Shibata)
proposal.page_topic: Domain councillors (職員) — end of Shizuoka's roster, start of Shibata's
proposal.page_summary_en: Fascicle 9 of the 1870 Hansei ichiran records domain officials and troops; this is printed page 452. The right two-thirds of the leaf completes the councillor roster of Shizuoka domain (靜岡藩, the Tokugawa house's 700,000-koku domain in Suruga): twenty-nine named officials in ten columns, of which the seven columns running left from 杉浦八郎五郎 stand under the heading 權少參事 (acting junior councillor), while the three rightmost columns — headed by 平岡四郎, 江原素六 and 向山黄村 — continue a rank block whose heading was printed on the preceding leaf. The ○新發田藩 marker then opens the block for Shibata domain (新發田藩, Echigo, 100,000 koku, Mizoguchi house), which supplies the leaf's only other five entries: two 大參事, 溝口伊織 and 窪田平兵衞, and three 權大參事, 溝口甚太郎, 速水八彌 and 溝口半兵衞. Nothing on the leaf is numeric — all thirty-four entries are personal names — so the page offers no koku, population or troop figures to reconcile.

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN: 3094x4551 px. I rendered the whole leaf at 1/3 scale, then ran an ink projection (px<110) over y=1400..2200 to find the vertical glyph runs; that gave 13 evenly pitched columns (pitch ~133 px) plus a narrower 14th at x~918-972 which holds the running header and the printed page number. I then ran a per-column row projection (y=300..4200, to exclude the black scan frame at top and bottom) for each column's vertical extent, and read every column in montage strips at 2.4-2.6x, dropping to 4-6.5x for single characters.

MARU-MARKERS: there is exactly ONE circle on this leaf, at x=2373-2443, y=1234, and it is NOT a domain marker -- what follows it is 館中入費, a section heading, not a domain name + 藩. No "circle + NAME + 藩" appears anywhere on the page. The right-to-left ownership rule therefore produces no split here: the whole leaf continues the block of the domain named in the running header, 嚴原藩 (Izuhara, i.e. Tsushima), and every box gets owner_domain_jp = 嚴原藩. neighbour_domains is empty -- nothing on this leaf is evidence of a second domain to either side of a marker.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT:
C1 (x2605-2705, y1402-3723) 但迎使三人上下九人通詞三人卒族拾貳人船附之者六人長崎逗留 -- a 但 note; it closes the item that began on the facing right-hand leaf.
C2 (x2504-2577) 旅籠之分右同斷 -- second note closing that same item.
C3 (x2373-2443) ○館中入費 -- new section heading. 入 verified at 6x (top stroke crosses; not 人/八).
C4 (x2230-2316, y1087-2385) 一 米七拾七石貳斗六升九合八勺八才 = 77.26988 koku. Sub-units strictly descending 石>斗>升>合>勺>才.
C5 (x2089-2178) 此精米六拾九石五斗四升貳合八勺九才 = 69.54289 koku.
C6 (x1962-2045, y1088-2298) 一 錢五千九百三拾五貫百四拾三文 = 5,935 kan 143 mon.
C7 (x1848-1908, y1236-1378) 小譯 -- two characters only. Read at 6.5x: the first glyph is 小 (hooked centre stroke plus two flanking dots, not 内); the second has the 言 radical on the left and 睪 on the right, so 譯. It heads the four columns that follow.
C8 (x1692-1777) 〃米四拾九石貳斗九升五合壹勺八才 = 49.29518 koku.
C9 (x1560-1641) 〃錢三千六百六拾九貫三百七拾五文 = 3,669 kan 375 mon.
C10 (x1415-1503, y1400-2970) 但在館役員渡筆墨紙代初入費一ヶ年凡如斯 -- the note explaining C8/C9.
C11 (x1298-1375) 〃米貳拾七石九斗七升四合七勺 = 27.9747 koku.
C12 (x1159-1239) 〃錢貳千貳百六拾五貫七百六拾八文 = 2,265 kan 768 mon.
C13 (x1005-1103, y1400-3387) 但館中建込之家々土藏板小屋普請入用大工飯米共如斯 -- the note explaining C11/C12.
HDR (x917-974, y1318-1869) 藩制一覧表第一（嚴原）; 嚴原 verified at 4x.
PGN (x893-941, y3151-3231) 十一 = printed book page 11.

ARITHMETIC NET (all three checks pass):
(1) Rice components sum to the rice total: 49.29518 + 27.97470 = 77.26988 koku exactly.
(2) Cash components sum to the cash total: 3,669,375 mon + 2,265,768 mon = 5,935,143 mon exactly, that is 5,935 kan 143 mon, since 1 kan = 1,000 mon.
(3) The 此精米 conversion is internally proportional: 77.26988 x 0.9 = 69.542892, and the page prints 69.54289 koku, so the polished-rice rate is exactly nine tenths.
The cash check settled the one glyph I was unsure of. My first pass read C12 as 貳千百六拾五貫 (2,165 kan), which left the components 100 kan short of the total; re-cropping C12 at 2.6x showed a second 貳 between 千 and 百, giving 貳千貳百六拾五貫 (2,265 kan), after which the sum closes on the printed 5,935 kan 143 mon. I also re-cropped the hundreds digit of C6 at 6x to rule out 八: it has the rounded bending leg of 九, so 5,935 and not 5,835, which the corrected sum independently confirms.

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing was cross-checked against the dataset; every value above comes from my own reading of the scan plus the three arithmetic checks.

BOXES: each box is the ink extent measured over that column's own y-range at threshold px<115, padded 10 px on all four sides. I checked all 105 box pairs programmatically for intersection and none overlap. The header box and the page-number box share an x band, but their y ranges are disjoint (1308-1879 against 3141-3241), so those two do not intersect either. One overlay pass was rendered and read; no box clips a glyph or sits on whitespace, so I did not render a second. I did not box the faint facing-page bleed-through in the lower right quadrant, nor the black scan frame.

proposal.page_summary_en: This leaf continues Izuhara (Tsushima) domain's fascicle-1 expenditure return and is given over to the cost of running the Wakan, the domain's walled trading and diplomatic compound at Pusan. Under the heading 館中入費 it reports an annual charge of 77.26988 koku of rice -- stated as 69.54289 koku when converted to polished rice, exactly nine tenths -- together with 5,935 kan 143 mon in cash. A breakdown then splits both totals in two: 49.29518 koku and 3,669 kan 375 mon for brushes, ink and paper issued to the officials stationed in the compound plus the initial outlays, and 27.9747 koku and 2,265 kan 768 mon for building the houses, earthen storehouses and board sheds inside it, the carpenters' rice rations included. The two right-hand columns close the preceding item, recording that the welcoming-envoy party -- three envoys, nine persons in all, three interpreters, twelve men of sotsu rank and six attached to the ship -- was quartered at Nagasaki, its lodging charged as above.

proposal.reasoning:
MARKERS: I looked for maru-markers (circle + name + 藩) across the whole text band and found NONE — the column ink-projection over y1150-4050 returned 14 text columns plus the running-header column and the printed page number, and no column begins with a ○. This is therefore a continuation page inside one domain's block, not a boundary page, so the right-of-marker / left-of-marker rule assigns nothing here: every box on the page belongs to the domain whose block was already running, 嚴原藩 (Izuhara / Tsushima). The running header at the far right prints 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）, which is provenance and here agrees with the content. There are no neighbour domains on this page.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (x-ranges from ink projection over the text band):
1. x2195-2252, y1374-1929 — running header 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）. Read at 3x and 4x: 藩/制/一/覽/表/第/一 then the parenthetical 嚴原. Not data.
2. x2066-2133, y1301-2098 — item mark 「、」 then 同五千七百六拾貫文 = 5,760 kanmon. Verified glyph by glyph at 3x: 五・千・七・百・六・拾 (拾 is the formal 10, not 千 — no slanted top stroke), 貫文.
3. x1933-2001, y1383-2102 — item mark then 三千四百五拾貫文 = 3,450 kanmon. No 同 head on this one; the value stands alone under the same expenditure head.
4. x1765-1869, y1451-3774 — 但書 part 1: 但他領漂民凡一ヶ年六巡与見右之漂民最合ニシテ凡三度ニテ迎. 与 is used phonetically for と; 最合 (もやい, "jointly") reads clearly at 3x.
5. x1644-1735, y1446-3018 — 但書 part 2 (the wrap of the same note): 取候見迎使乘船三艘往來借入之船賃凡如斯. The note closes with 凡如斯 ("roughly as shown"), so it qualifies the two cash figures to its right (5,760 and 3,450 kanmon).
6. x1534-1605, y1357-2008 — 同貳千三百四貫文 = 2,304 kanmon (no leading item mark on this column).
7. x1362-1470, y1445-3762 — 但書: 但右漂民六巡之內乘船破損凡三艘と見積船長崎ニテ借入船賃右.
8. x1278-1334, y1443-1588 — 同斷, the two-glyph wrap of column 7; the note ends 「…船賃右同斷」.
9. x1106-1209, y1288-2508 — item mark then 米貳拾石四斗壹升四合八勺壹才. Sub-koku units are strictly descending 石>斗>升>合>勺>才 with no skips, so the reading is internally consistent: 20 + 0.4 + 0.01 + 0.004 + 0.0008 + 0.00001 = 20.41481 koku.
10. x994-1075, y1285-2335 — item mark then 錢貳千九百四拾六貫六百文 = 2,946 kan 600 mon.
11. x831-933, y1437-3750 — 但書 part 1: 但右漂民六巡三度ニテ長崎ゟ迎取候と見迎送トシテ同所に召仕.
12. x696-799, y1434-3759 — 但書 part 2: 候中士三人警固卒族拾貳人通詞且船附之者ニ至宛行之分尤朝鮮.
13. x576-666, y1430-3002 — 但書 part 3: 國に送還之節召仕候警固之者宛行共右同斷. This three-column note ends 右同斷 and so qualifies the rice figure (20.41481 koku) and the cash figure (2,946 kan 600 mon) to its right — allowances paid partly in rice, partly in cash.
14. x449-536, y1274-2497 — item mark then 錢貳千三百四拾九貫七百五拾文 = 2,349 kan 750 mon. This column sits to the LEFT of the note that closes with 右同斷 and carries its own item mark, so it opens a new line-item whose explanatory note falls on the following (left-hand) half-page.
15. x2173-2219, y3210-3252 — the printed book-page number 十 in the lower margin. Boxed as page furniture, not data.

GLYPH DECISIONS I CHECKED AT SINGLE-CHARACTER MAGNIFICATION:
- The small cursive kana after 三艘 (col 7) and after 迎取候 (col 11) is 「と」, not ト. I cropped the katakana ト in トシテ (col 11) at 8x for comparison: ト is a plain vertical with one right branch, while this glyph has a hooked top, a crossing stroke and a bottom that turns right. Column 4 writes the same particle with the phonetic 与.
- 「ゟ」 (yori) after 長崎 (col 11) is the looped ligature, confirmed at 8x. The smaller cursive kana after 同所 (col 11) and after 國 (col 13) is a different, shorter glyph — hiragana 「に」 — so I read 同所に召仕候 and 朝鮮國に送還, while the two-bar katakana ニ appears separately in 三度ニテ, 長崎ニテ and 者ニ至.
- CAVEAT: the glyph between 見 and 船 in column 7 is heavily over-inked. I rendered it binarized at 9x and compared it with 損 from the same column (clearly different left radical — not 扌) and with 船/艘. I read it as 積, giving 「凡三艘と見積、船長崎ニテ借入」("estimated at about three vessels; boats hired at Nagasaki"), which is the only reading that parses cleanly with the preceding と. 繕 and 續 were considered and are graphically possible; this one character should be treated as provisional.

ARITHMETIC: there is no total-and-components group on this page — every figure is a separate line-item under its own 但書, and no 内訳 or 合計 is printed — so no sum check applies. The rice figure was validated instead by the strict descending order of its sub-koku units.

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing here is a cross-check against the dataset; all readings are taken from the scan.

OVERLAY: one pass rendered to _final.png and read back at 1/3 scale. All 15 boxes sit flush on their columns, none clips a glyph, none sits on whitespace, and the minimum horizontal gap between adjacent boxes is 7 px (between the 同斷 box and the note column to its right), so no box overlaps another. No corrections were needed, so no second pass was run.
proposal.page_header_en: Han System Overview Table, Fascicle One (Izuhara)
proposal.page_topic: Costs of receiving and repatriating Korean castaways
proposal.page_summary_en: A continuation page inside the Izuhara (Tsushima) return in fascicle one, listing the domain's outlays for taking in and repatriating castaways. Three cash items appear with explanatory notes: 5,760 kanmon and 3,450 kanmon for hiring the three vessels the receiving envoys boarded on their round trips, reckoning castaways from other domains at about six rounds a year fetched in about three journeys; 2,304 kanmon for boats hired at Nagasaki after about three of the vessels used on those six rounds were damaged; and 20.41481 koku of rice together with 2,946 kan 600 mon in cash for the allowances paid to three middle-rank samurai, twelve sotsu-rank guards, interpreters and the ship's crew engaged at Nagasaki for reception and escort, the same allowances applying to the guards employed when the castaways were sent back to Korea. A fourth item, 2,349 kan 750 mon, opens at the left edge and its explanatory note runs onto the facing half-page. The printed page number is 10.

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN 3094x4551; paper interior measured at cols 539-3078, rows 253-4264 (bright-region projection). The run at x 3035-3075 / y 2824-4259 is scan-frame black, not ink (crop confirmed) and is not boxed. A 7x8 px speck at x 1573-1579 / y 2222-2229 is also skipped.

MARKERS: I looked for a maru-marker (circle + NAME + 藩) across the whole page and there is NONE. The page is a continuation leaf, so the right-to-left ownership rule has nothing to split here: every column on the page belongs to one and the same domain. That domain is identified by the running header in the left margin, 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）— Izuhara (Tsushima). owner_domain_jp = 嚴原藩 on all nineteen boxes. neighbour_domains is therefore empty; the preceding domain's block ended before this leaf and the next domain's marker has not yet appeared.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (ink-projection column runs on the interior: 2624-2720, 2470-2576, 2382-2446, 2228-2328, 2079-2207, 1945-2055, 1814-1921, 1714-1786, 1571-1652, 1430-1516, 1381-1421, 1291-1379, 1133-1237, 1048-1110, 894-981):
1. x2623-2719 y1131-2508: 一米百八拾八石四斗六升五合四勺壹才 = 188.46541 koku. Sub-units strictly descending 石>斗>升>合>勺>才.
2. x2470-2575 y1440-3766: the 但 note 但朝鮮國通辨之者并町役共四拾壹人給米相與候分尤渡方異同有, which wraps into
3. x2381-2445 y1436-1581: 之事 (two glyphs only). I boxed the wrap as a separate box rather than one 214x2350 rectangle, because a single box spanning both columns would be three-quarters dead margin under 之事.
4. x2227-2327 y1103-2669: 合米四千六百拾五石六斗五升八合壹勺九才 = 4,615.65819 koku.
5. x2078-2206 y1182-2476: a warichu. The 合 glyph (measured x2125-2189, y1182-~1245) spans BOTH sub-columns, so this is one box, not two. Right sub-column 錢貳萬七千六百七拾九貫九百四拾八文; left sub-column 金ニシテ貳千七百六拾七兩九合九勺四才. The two sub-columns nearly touch (column-ink minimum of 149 px at x=2131), which is a second reason not to split them.
   ARITHMETIC CHECK on this pair: 27,679貫948文 = 27,679.948 kan; at 10 kan to the ryo that is 2,767.9948 ryo. The printed conversion reads 2,767兩9合9勺4才, i.e. 2,767.994 ryo with 合=0.1兩, 勺=0.01兩, 才=0.001兩. The two reconcile at exactly ten kan per ryo, the printed figure truncating the fourth decimal. Note that after 兩 these three glyphs are decimal fractions of a ryo, NOT the koku sub-units 0.001/0.0001/0.00001.
6. Same column band, lower run y2778-3173, x2085-2149: 合金貳千兩 = 2,000 ryo.
7. x1971-2055 y1182-1913: 合丹木千四百五拾斤 = 1,450 catties of sappanwood.
8. x1944-2018 y2774-3255: 合大豆貳拾俵 = 20 bales of soybeans.
9. x1846-1921 y1184-1743: 合木綿百五拾疋 = 150 bolts of cotton cloth (last glyph 疋, checked at 3x).
10. x1813-1882 y2777-3088: 合銅千斤 = 1,000 catties of copper. 千 here has the slanted top stroke; the page-number 十 at the foot does not — I checked both at 5-7x so as not to make a x100 error.
11. x1714-1785 y1264-1661: 參判使入費, a section heading (not data). It starts at y1264, at heading height with 小譯 (y1253), while the 但 notes are indented lower (y1422, y1440) — that indent is what tells headings from notes on this leaf.
12. x1571-1651 y1118-1745: 一木綿四百五拾尺 = 450 shaku.
13. x1430-1516 y1114-2242: 一米六拾貳石壹斗三合七勺八才 = 62.10378 koku (升 place skipped = 0; order still descending 斗>合>勺>才).
14. x1381-1421 y1511-1595: two small-type glyphs 百 and カ — the 1928 editor's conjecture mark 「百ヵ」. It sits to the RIGHT of column 15 and so annotates column 15, level with that column's sixth glyph.
15. x1291-1379 y1112-2408: 一錢三千三拾四拾四貫七百四拾八文. I segmented this column glyph by glyph (16 glyphs; the 三 characters resolve into three thin strokes each) and re-zoomed glyphs 5-9 at 6x: the sequence really is 三 拾 四 拾 四 貫. As printed that is malformed — 三千三拾四拾四 is not a well-formed numeral — which is precisely why the editor set 「百ヵ」 beside the first 拾. Emended to 三千三百四拾四貫 the figure is 3,344 kan 748 mon, which is well formed. I transcribe the printed text verbatim and parse the emended value, flagging it.
16. x1133-1236 y1422-3328: 但參判使在館中諸入費且往來入用共平均ニシテ如斯 (one continuous column; the 60 px gap between 費 and 且 is glyph spacing, not a break).
17. x1048-1110 y1253-1395: 小譯, two glyphs, a section heading. The second glyph is heavily ink-filled; at 10x with autocontrast the left radical resolves as 言 and the right as 罒 over 幸, giving 譯. Being the leftmost content column it is read last, and its entries run onto the following leaf.
18. x919-981 y1336-1893: running header 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）— provenance. It names Izuhara and the data on the page is Izuhara's, so header and content agree here.
19. x893-935 y3178-3271: printed page number 十三 (plain cross, so 十 not 千).

WHAT I COULD NOT CHECK: the 合 lines are totals of item lines printed on the facing right-hand page, so those sums cannot be verified from this leaf alone. The one arithmetic net available on this page — the cash-to-gold conversion in box 5 — reconciles, as set out above.

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing was cross-checked against it; every reading above is from the scan.

GEOMETRY: boxes padded ~10 px off measured ink, except around the small 「百ヵ」 note where the gap to the neighbouring column is only 8 px and the pad was cut to 4-5 px. A programmatic pairwise test over all nineteen boxes returned zero overlaps, and the rendered overlay confirms every printed element is enclosed with no box sitting on whitespace, so one overlay pass was enough.
proposal.page_header_en: Table of Domain Institutions, Fascicle One (Izuhara)
proposal.page_topic: Izuhara (Tsushima) Korea-trade totals and envoy expenses
proposal.page_summary_en: The left-hand side of leaf 13 continues the Izuhara (Tsushima) return in fascicle one, setting out the domain's Korea-trade account. The running totals are 4,615.65819 koku of rice, 2,000 ryo in gold, 27,679 kan 948 mon in copper cash (glossed in an interlinear conversion as 2,767.994 ryo, an exact rate of ten kan to the ryo), 1,450 catties of sappanwood, 1,000 catties of copper, 150 bolts of cotton cloth and 20 bales of soybeans; a separate item of 188.46541 koku of rice is annotated as the allowance shared among forty-one men, the Korean-language interpreters together with the town officials. Under the heading Sanpanshi nyuhi (expenses of the Sanpan envoy) come 450 shaku of cotton cloth, 62.10378 koku of rice and 3,344 kan 748 mon in cash, which a closing note says are averages covering the envoy's residence at the Japan House and his journey out and back; the 1928 editor marks the last of those figures with a conjecture, since the character as printed leaves the numeral malformed. The leaf ends with the heading Shoyaku (junior interpreter), whose entries run on to the next page.

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN 3095x4551. Ink-projection over y900-3450, x150-2620 (thresholds <120; the full-height projection is useless because the black scan frame inks every row/column) gives exactly 14 vertical glyph runs. Row-projection inside each run gives the glyph slots, and glyph pitch is a uniform ~88 px, which let me confirm glyph counts against each transcription.

MARU-MARKERS: there are NONE on this page. No circle+name+藩 appears anywhere in the 14 runs (checked every run's top glyph at 5x). The page therefore sits wholly inside one domain block, so the right-to-left ownership rule has nothing to divide here: every box belongs to the same domain. That domain is named by the running header, 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）— fascicle 1, Izuhara (Tsushima). The content confirms it independently: all four breakdown items are 和館 expenditures, the Japan House at Pusan that Tsushima alone operated. neighbour_domains is empty for the same reason — no marker, no boundary.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (x ranges native):
- x2198-2289 holds TWO separate runs in one outer-margin column: the header 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）at y1360-1916, and the printed book-page number 十二 at y3195-3287. Boxed separately.
- x2087-2177, y1129-2429, 16 glyph slots: 一米三千三百貳拾三石九斗八合六勺 = 3,323.9086 koku. The first slot (y1129-1138, only 10 px tall) is the item marker 一, a single horizontal bar; zoomed at 5x to confirm it is 一 and that 米 follows at y1188.
- x1943-2043, y1269-3008, 21 glyphs: 此精米貳千九百九拾壹石五斗壹升七合七勺四才 = 2,991.51774 koku.
- x1823-1912, y1127-2256, 14 glyphs: 一錢貳百三拾四貫五百六拾七文 = 234 kan 567 mon.
- x1711-1776, y1270-1413, 2 glyphs: 小譯 (itemized breakdown heading; zoomed at 5x — 言+睪, not 内譯).
- x1539-1639, 19 glyphs: 〃米千四百七拾四石九斗三升六合六勺壹才 = 1,474.93661.
- x1414-1501, 14 glyphs: 〃錢貳百三拾四貫五百六拾七文 = 234 kan 567 mon (the whole cash total falls to this one sub-item).
- x1273-1366, 16 glyphs: 但和館在留役員給金米一ヶ年凡如斯.
- x1143-1235, 18 glyphs: 〃米三百九拾三石壹斗五升八合壹勺貳才 = 393.15812.
- x991-1099, 22 glyphs: 但和館往來役員船中飯米且大小船水夫飯米凡如斯.
- x873-964, 17 glyphs: 〃同百四拾六石貳斗貳升六合五勺六才 = 146.22656.
- x733-824, 15 glyphs: 但和館往來大船水夫留守扶持如斯.
- x598-692, 17 glyphs: 〃米千三百九石五斗八升七合三勺壹才 = 1,309.58731. A 7-px speck at y3002-3009 in this column is an ink fleck, not a glyph; not boxed.
- x474-557, 11 glyphs: 但右同斷大船賃米高如斯.
The 但 notes all start at y~1420-1431, one glyph slot lower than the value columns (y~1270-1280) — the standard 但書 indent — which is how each note pairs with the value column to its right: 但-note at x1273 covers x1539+x1414, x991 covers x1143, x733 covers x873, x474 covers x598.

ARITHMETIC NET, both checks pass exactly:
(1) 3,323.9086 x 0.9 = 2,991.51774 — the printed 此精米 is the total at the standard 9-wari brown-to-polished conversion, to the last 才.
(2) The four 小譯 items sum to the total: 1,474.93661 + 393.15812 + 146.22656 + 1,309.58731 = 3,323.90860 = the printed 米 total.
Check (2) is what corrected a misreading. My first pass read the third item as 八合 (146.22856), which left the sum 0.002 koku (2 go) over the printed total. I cropped that single glyph (x876-961, y2178-2248) at 7x and it is 六 — it has the 亠 top dot and lid; the 八 in the neighbouring item at x1146, y2273-2329 has no lid. Correcting to 六合 makes the four items sum exactly. In the earlier 3-panel strip that glyph had straddled a panel boundary, which cut its lid off and made it look like 八 — the known 六/八 trap in the reading guide.

MASTER: this page has no extracted rows at all. Nothing to cross-check against, and the page is a genuine data page (eight numeric values), so the gap is in MASTER, not in the source.

proposal.page_topic: Izuhara (Tsushima) outlays in rice and cash for the Wakan at Pusan
proposal.page_summary_en: This page records Izuhara (Tsushima) domain's annual expenditure on the Wakan, the Japan House at Pusan through which the domain conducted the Korea trade. The totals are 3,323.9086 koku of rice, which the survey restates as 2,991.51774 koku of polished rice at the standard nine-tenths conversion, and 234 kan 567 mon in cash. A 小譯 (itemized breakdown) then divides the rice into four charges: 1,474.93661 koku for the salaries of officials resident at the Wakan, which also absorbs the whole of the 234 kan 567 mon in cash; 393.15812 koku for shipboard meal rice for officials travelling to and from the Wakan together with meal rice for the crews of the large and small vessels; 146.22656 koku in retaining allowances for the large vessel's crew while it lay idle; and 1,309.58731 koku for the hire of the large vessel. The four items sum exactly to the printed total.

proposal.reasoning:
MARKER SURVEY. I scanned the whole page for maru-markers by ink projection (rows 300-4200, cols 520-3080, ink = px<120) and then read every column head at 2x-8x. There is exactly ONE circle glyph on the page, at x=2394-2460, y=1164, and it heads the run ○和漂民入費. That is a SECTION heading ("expenses for Japanese castaways"), NOT a domain marker — no 藩 follows it and no domain name precedes it. So the right-of-marker / left-of-marker rule does not partition this page: there is no domain boundary on it. Ownership is settled instead by the running header, which I read at 4x: 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）. The facing page of the same spread (upper_p020_right, book page 十四) prints the identical header （嚴原）, so the whole spread sits inside the 嚴原藩 (Izuhara, Tsushima) block of fascicle 1. Every box therefore gets owner_domain_jp = 嚴原藩, and neighbour_domains is empty.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (14 ink columns found; the band at x=3068-3080 is the scan frame and the band at x=520-552 the left frame — neither boxed. Faint mid-page ghosting is facing-page bleed-through, much lighter than the 120 threshold, and is not boxed.)

R1 x2652-2731 y1410-3738 — 但參判使一行在館中飯米且外向ニ差遣候音物銀其外一行中ニ旅 (28 glyphs / 2328 px = 83 px per cell, consistent). A 但 note closing the entry carried over from book page 十四.
R2 x2524-2595 y1409-2067 — 粧限相與候分如斯 (8 glyphs, 82 px per cell). Second column of the same note; 旅 + 粧 = 旅粧, travel outfitting.
R3 x2394-2460 y1164-1645 — ○和漂民入費. Section heading.
R4 x2259-2327 y1101-1978 — 一米八拾石九合四勺貳才. Sub-units strictly descending 石 > (斗 skipped) > (升 skipped) > 合 > 勺 > 才, so 80 + 0.009 + 0.0004 + 0.00002 = 80.00942 koku.
R5 x2123-2194 y1103-2403 — 一錢五千四百八拾六貫八百貳拾貳文. I checked 千 against 十 at the glyph: the second numeral has the slanted stroke sitting on top, so this is 5,486 kan, and the tail reads 822 mon.
R6 x1992-2055 y1256-1399 — two glyphs only. I zoomed the first at 8x to rule out 內: it has a centre hook with a dot either side, so it is 小, and the pair reads 小譯 (= 小訳, a sub-itemization; 譯 is the kyujitai of 訳 as in 内訳). It sits one full cell lower than the 一 item lines, the same indent the facing page 十六 uses for its heading 譯官渡來入費.
R7 x1852-1923 — 〃米五石壹斗六合三勺八才 = 5.10638 koku.
R8 x1714-1787 — 〃錢千六百六拾八貫九百八拾八文 = 1,668 kan 988 mon.
R9 x1575-1651 — 但和漂民朝鮮國在留中諸入費凡如斯 (16 glyphs, 83 px per cell).
R10 x1445-1518 — 〃米三拾七石七斗五升六合貳勺六才 = 37.75626 koku.
R11 x1314-1386 — 〃錢百六拾九貫八百三拾四文 = 169 kan 834 mon.
R12 x1163-1247 y1423-3752 — 但右同斷ニ付別段差渡候三拾人之人夫ニ相與候賃銀飯米之分如斯 (29 glyphs, 80 px per cell). I zoomed the kunten marks at 4x: the mark before 人夫 is the cursive 之, the mark after 夫 is the hentaigana ニ, and 但右同斷 is followed by a printed small 二. The word is 賃銀 (wage-silver), not 貫銀 — the glyph has 貝 under 任, and the facing page 十四 prints 賃銀飯米相與候分 in the same formula.
R13 x1043-1116 — 〃米八石五斗七升七合七勺七才 = 8.57777 koku. All four low-order digits are 七 (horizontal with an L-hook), not 九.
R14 x923-983 — two ink runs: y1339-1899 the running header 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）, and y3178-3272 the printed book-page number 十五. Boxed separately. The stray 6-px speck at y944 in this band and the 3-px speck at y2795 in R10's band are dirt and are not boxed.

ARITHMETIC NET. 小譯 announces a breakdown, so the 米 items after it should sum to the 米 total in R4. On this page they give 5.10638 + 37.75626 + 8.57777 = 51.44041, short of 80.00942. The list continues onto the facing leaf, so I opened upper_p021_right (book page 十六) and cropped its two rice items at 2x: 〃同拾四石五斗六升九合壹才 = 14.56901 and 〃同拾四石 = 14.00000. Then 5.10638 + 37.75626 + 8.57777 + 14.56901 + 14.00000 = 80.00942, exactly the total printed in R4. That reconciliation is what fixes 小譯 as "breakdown" rather than "junior interpreter," and it independently confirms every sub-koku digit I read in R4, R7, R10 and R13. I did NOT verify the cash side: the 錢 components continuing on page 十六 were seen only at one-third scale, so I make no claim that they sum to 5,486 kan 822 mon.

MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing was cross-checked against it; every reading here is off the scan.

BOX METHOD. Each box came from an ink projection inside its own column band (threshold px<120, first-to-last inked row and column) padded 10 px, so a box runs from the top of the leading glyph (但 / ○ / 一 / 〃) to the bottom of the last glyph. I rendered the 15 boxes onto the scan once, read the render, and found no clipped glyph, no box sitting on whitespace and no overlap; a programmatic pairwise intersection test over the 15 rectangles also reported none. A second corrective pass was therefore not needed.

proposal.page_summary_en: This leaf continues Izuhara (Tsushima) domain's account of its Korea-related outlays in fascicle 1 of the Hansei Ichiran. It opens with the closing note of the preceding entry, covering ration rice for the Sanpanshi envoy party while lodged at the Japan House, the gift-silver dispatched for external presentation, and the travel-outfitting allowance granted to members of the party. A new section then opens at ○和漂民入費, expenses for Japanese castaways, with totals of 80.00942 koku of rice and 5,486 kan 822 mon in cash. Under the heading 小譯 (breakdown) the page itemizes three components — 5.10638 koku with 1,668 kan 988 mon for the castaways' upkeep while resident in Korea, 37.75626 koku with 169 kan 834 mon for the wage-silver and rations of thirty labourers dispatched separately, and 8.57777 koku opening a further item — with the remaining components running onto book page 十六, where the five rice figures sum exactly to the 80.00942 koku total.

c1 x484-551 — 〃錢千五百四拾六貫文.

Every value column opens with the same small double-tick item bullet, which I cropped at 8x; it is the HI list bullet, and I record it as 〃 at the head of each transcribing string. The four 但/gloss columns carry no bullet, which is what marks them as notes rather than entries.

GLYPH CHECKS. I cropped every column at 1.4x-2.6x and any doubtful character at 4x-10x. 米 vs 木: c13 is 木綿 (tree radical, no 八 legs); c12/c8/c4 are 米. 八 vs 六 vs 人: in c10 (八百九拾九貫六百八拾七文) the 八 glyphs are split at the top and splay, the 六 has its top dot and lid, and the 人 in c6's 五拾人夫 has its two strokes touching at the apex. 千 vs 十: c1's second glyph has the slanted ノ on top, so it is 千 (1,546 kan), not 十 — a x100 trap I checked at 1.9x. 隼 in c3 I cropped at 6x: it is 隼 (falcon), not 早, so the phrase is 小隼, not 小早.

ARITHMETIC. These eight lines are independent expenditure entries — there is no total, no 内訳, and no male/female split on this page, so the sum-check net has nothing to reconcile; I state that rather than claim a check I did not run. What I did verify on every koku figure is the descending-place rule: 三石五斗三升三合三勺三才 = 3.53333; 拾九石壹斗八升八合八勺八才 = 19.18888; 貳拾四石七斗四升五合四勺六才 = 24.74546; 拾四石六斗三升六合壹勺壹才 = 14.63611. All four run 石>斗>升>合>勺>才 with no place out of order and every place digit 0-9, so no misread surfaces. Cash: 899貫687文 = 899,687 mon; 589貫61文 = 589,061 mon; 1,546貫文 = 1,546,000 mon — all with 貫 before 文 in order.

PAIRING. c6's note names 賃銀飯米 for fifty extra labourers, and the two entries immediately to its right are one rice figure (c8, the 飯米) and one cash figure (c7, the 賃銀) — the commodity assignment is unambiguous. c3's note names 水夫飯米 and the entry to its right (c4) is rice. The last two entries, c2 (同 = rice, 14.63611 koku) and c1 (1,546 kanmon), have no note on this leaf; their gloss would continue on the following page, so I have named those two boxes from their printed values alone and claimed no purpose for them.

MASTER. MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so there was nothing to cross-check against; the transcriptions here are read off the scan only.

BOXES. Each box was measured by cropping a rough region, thresholding px<120, projecting onto rows and columns, taking first..last inked row/column and padding 10px. I checked every adjacent pair for overlap numerically (c1 right edge 562 vs c2 left 600; c2 699 vs c3 721; c3 829 vs c4 868; c4 967 vs c5 1010; c5 1097 vs c6 1121; c6 1233 vs c7 1275; c7 1371 vs c8 1405; c8 1502 vs c9 1533; c9 1632 vs c10 1673; c10 1774 vs c11 1805; c11 1901 vs c12 1944; c12 2036 vs c13note 2069; c13val 2171 vs header 2210) — no two boxes touch. One overlay pass was rendered to _final.png and read back at 1/3 scale: no box clips a glyph, none sits on whitespace, and the faint facing-page bleed-through (the much lighter ghost glyphs near x1000-1100 and x1900-2000 mid-page), the binding-edge black at the left of the scan, and the scan frame are all left unboxed. No box needed moving, so I did not render a second time.

proposal.page_topic: Izuhara domain's Korea-mission and Wakan expenditures
proposal.page_summary_en: This leaf continues Izuhara (Tsushima) domain's fascicle-one return with eight expenditure entries tied to the domain's Korea diplomacy and trade. Two are gifts to Korean-side officials: 450 bolts of cotton cloth to the panji, and 3.53333 koku of rice — six bales of polished rice — to the junior interpreter on the same footing. Three more cover the sanpanshi envoy's mission: 899,687 mon as the averaged running expenses while the envoy was resident at the Wakan, and 19.18888 koku of ration rice with 589,061 mon of wage-silver for the fifty extra labourers dispatched for his crossing. A further 24.74546 koku of ration rice feeds the boatmen of the envoy's passenger vessel, the No. 2 ship, the small Hayabusa tow-boat and the lead rowing boat; the leaf closes with a further 14.63611 koku of rice and 1,546,000 mon whose explanatory note runs on past the page.

proposal.reasoning:
MARKERS AND OWNERSHIP. I scanned the whole page with an ink projection (threshold px<120) and found fifteen substantive vertical runs plus three specks (x1566 y~1500s, x1698-1714 y395-410, and single-row dots at x2681-2746 y1780/y2040, plus a speck at x1202-1301 y2786-2807). No maru-marker (○ + name + 藩) prints anywhere on this leaf: the rightmost element is the two-glyph heading 小譯 at x2681-2745, y1235-1378, not a domain marker. The right-to-left rule therefore has nothing to divide here — the page sits wholly inside a domain block opened on an earlier leaf. MASTER confirms it: 嚴原藩 (Tsushima) opens with the marker row ○嚴原藩 at upper pdf_page 13 side L, table 1, and MASTER also holds table-1 rows for this domain on pdf pages 14, 15, 16, 22 and 23 — pdf 21 is simply an unextracted page in the middle of that run. The running header at the far left, 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）, names the same domain, so provenance and content agree. Every box on the page is owned by 嚴原藩; neighbour_domains is empty.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (measured ink extents in parentheses).
C1 (x2681-2745, y1235-1378): 小譯, two glyphs, the highest starting point on the page — the group heading. Read as 小譯官（使）, the lesser Korean interpreter-envoy mission, the counterpart to a 大譯 heading that would stand on the preceding leaf. Not data.
C2 (x2521-2607, y1329-2722): a 〃 ditto mark at the top (zoomed at 8x: two joined slanted strokes, the nonoten, standing where the item bullet 一 would sit), then 米貳百貳拾石六斗四升五合八勺七才. Sub-units descend 石>斗>升>合>勺>才 with no skip: 220 + 0.6 + 0.04 + 0.005 + 0.0008 + 0.00007 = 220.64587 koku.
C3 (x2391-2473, y1329-2638): 〃 錢六千六百五拾三貫七百六拾五文 = 6,653 kan 765 mon. Checked 千 against 十 at the second glyph — the slanted ノ sits on top, so 六千 not 六十.

C8 (x1730-1818, y1324-2634): 〃 米四拾八石四斗七升六合八勺七才 = 48 + 0.4 + 0.07 + 0.006 + 0.0008 + 0.00007 = 48.47687 koku.
C9 (x1602-1682, y1322-2298): 〃 錢千三百八拾貫四拾四文 = 1,380 kan 44 mon.
C10 (x1469-1549, y1483-2382): 但送五日次方諸入用如斯, the note on the C8/C9 pair.
C11 (x1337-1417, y1317-2377): 〃 錢貳千百三貫貳百九拾七文 = 2,103 kan 297 mon.
C12 (x1202-1301, y1387-2375): 銅八千四百拾三斤壹勺八才 = 8,413 kin of copper. This column alone starts with no 〃. Two small marks print to the right of 勺 and of 才, at x1280-1301; I measured their darkness (min grey 18) against the main glyphs (min 13) and they are true ink, not facing-page bleed, and at 12x each resolves as a small katakana マ over a second blurred マ — the editorial ママ (sic) of the 1928 日本史籍協會 reprint, flagging the manuscript's use of koku sub-unit names (勺, 才) after a weight unit (斤). I kept them inside the C12 box and parsed only the 斤 quantity. MASTER's own Izuhara row at pdf 16R records 荒銅貳萬六千九百斤, so 斤 is this domain's copper unit.
C13 (x1045-1149, y1472-3552): 但堂上以下に定式相與候諸品代リ銅ヲ以テ相渡候分如斯. The small glyph after 以下 resolves at 9x as hiragana に. This note closes the page and explains the C11/C12 pair.
C14 (x965-1027, y1306-1866): the running header 藩制一覽表第一（嚴原）; the 覽 glyph zoomed at 8x shows the dense multi-part kyujitai top over 見. Below it, at x935-987, y3149-3249, the printed book-page number 十七 (plain cross 十, not 千).

ARITHMETIC. No total prints on this page, so there is no sum to reconcile: the three rice figures and the four cash figures are separate expense accounts and the copper is a fourth commodity. What I did check is the sub-unit ordering on all three rice values — each descends 石→斗→升→合→勺→才 with every place filled and each digit 0-9, so none of them hides a dropped or phantom place.

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER supplied no rows for this page, so nothing here contradicts or confirms it cell by cell; the domain attribution and the 斤 unit for copper are the two points where MASTER's neighbouring Izuhara rows corroborate my reading.

GEOMETRY. Fifteen boxes, each from the measured ink bounds with about 9 px of horizontal and 10 px of vertical pad (8 px on the left of C13 and 6 px on the right of the header column, where the gutter is only 18 px). A programmatic pairwise intersection test over all fifteen returned no overlaps. One overlay render was enough — reading it back showed no clipped glyph, no box on whitespace and no collision, so I did not need the second pass.

proposal.page_topic: Costs of hosting the lesser Korean interpreter-envoy mission (小譯)
proposal.page_summary_en: This left-hand leaf, printed book page 17 of fascicle one, continues the 嚴原藩 (Izuhara, Tsushima) entry and stands entirely under one heading, 小譯 — the lesser Korean interpreter-envoy mission. Three paired accounts follow, each reckoned on the five-day provisioning cycle used for Korean envoys and each closed by a 但 note: 220.64587 koku of rice with 6,653 kan 765 mon in cash for the period the interpreter-officials were in residence; 16.45227 koku with 843 kan 894 mon for receiving them; and 48.47687 koku with 1,380 kan 44 mon for seeing them off. A fourth pair records 2,103 kan 297 mon in cash and 8,413 kin of copper, which the closing note explains was handed over in copper in place of the goods customarily presented to the 堂上 senior interpreter-officials and those below them. No maru-marker prints on the page and no grand total is given, so all fifteen elements belong to 嚴原藩 and the seven money-and-grain figures stand as separate accounts.

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN: 3095x4551 native. Rendered full page with a 200px grid, then ran an ink-projection (px<120) over the paper area x300-2350, y1000-3900. It returned exactly 14 vertical glyph runs (columns), listed here right to left with their x extents: 2174-2249, 2037-2128, 1925-2002, 1781-1865, 1666-1734, 1526-1600, 1369-1464, 1253-1328, 1129-1205, 973-1067, 850-926, 728-796, 582-661, 454-533. Plus one detached run in the rightmost column at y3189-3282 (the printed page number).

MARU-MARKERS: there are NONE on this page. I checked the top of every one of the 14 columns at 4x (tops.png): the four short value columns open with a ditto mark 〃 followed by 同 or 錢; the two long left-hand value columns open with 一; the six 但-notes open with 但; the twelfth column opens with 譯; the rightmost column is the running header. No circle + name + 藩 anywhere. The right-to-left rule therefore assigns the whole page to a single domain: nothing on the page starts a new domain, so every column continues the block that began on the preceding page. Owner for all 15 boxes = 嚴原藩.

HEADER / PROVENANCE: the rightmost column reads 藩制一覧表第一（嚴原）, zoomed at 2.2-3.0x (hdr2.png, hdr3.png) — 藩制一覧表第一 at y1348-1690 and （嚴原） at y1745-1900. 第一 = fascicle 1, so table_number = 1. The header names 嚴原 and the data is 嚴原's, so header and data agree here. Printed page number at the bottom of the same column, zoomed 4x: 十六 (pgno2.png).

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (the 但-notes follow the value they annotate, so each note belongs to the column immediately to its RIGHT):
1. x2037-2128, 26 char cells by row-projection: 但右同斷ニ付兩關所ニテ召仕候人夫ゟ相與候飯米之分如斯. It opens 但右同斷 ("same as at right"), so the value it annotates stands at the end of the PREVIOUS page, not on this one. ニテ verified at 5x (gl3.png) — 所, then ニ (two strokes), then テ (short top bar + long bar + diagonal), not ヲ.
